title.en: Russian ‘attempts to intimidate Europe will fail’, says EU’s Kallas as Germany blames Moscow for Leipzig drone incident – Europe live
title.zh: 欧盟就德国指责莫斯科策划的事件举行会谈，回应列日无人机袭击

summary.en: The EU is holding talks on how to respond to a drone attack last month, which Germany has formally blamed on Moscow. The EU's foreign policy chief stated the attack had 'all the hallmarks of state sponsored terrorism' and aimed to divide Europe and deter support for Ukraine, vowing that this attempt would fail....
summary.zh: 欧盟正在就如何回应上个月的无人机袭击事件举行会谈，德国已正式指责莫斯科是幕后黑手。欧盟外交政策主管表示，此次袭击具有“国家支持的恐怖主义的所有特征”，旨在分裂欧洲并阻止对乌克兰的支持，并誓言这一企图将失败。英国外交大臣也参加了此次讨论。

body.en: EU’s policy chief says drone incident at German airport ‘had the hallmarks of state-sponsored terrorism’ German police have opened a investigation into yesterday’s attempt to disrupt the operation of a power substation near Brandenburg. In a statement , Brandenburg police said they were leading a probe on suspicion of attempting to disrupt public services, causing an explosion and damaging critical infrastructure as well as forming a terrorist organisation Continue reading...
body.zh: 外交政策负责人在准备主持今天的讨论时表示，上个月的无人机袭击“具有国家支持的恐怖主义的所有特征”。英国外交大臣埃德·米利班德也参加了今天在爱尔兰举行的会谈。 “我们看到俄罗斯试图在欧洲分裂我们，并阻止我们支持乌克兰。今天我代表英国明确表示，这一企图将会失败。” 继续阅读...

reflection.en: The accusation of state-sponsored terrorism in the Leipzig drone attack presents a stark challenge to the international community. It tempts a response fueled by anger and a desire for retribution. Yet, the call to overcome evil with good, rather than being overcome by it, remains a difficult but vital path. May wisdom guide the leaders gathered, that their...
reflection.zh: 列日无人机袭击事件被指控为国家支持的恐怖主义，这给国际社会带来了严峻的挑战。它诱使人们以愤怒和报复的欲望来回应。然而，‘以善胜恶，不可被恶所胜’的呼吁，虽然艰难，却仍然是一条至关重要的道路。愿聚集的领导者们能获得智慧的指引，使他们的回应能够缓和局势而非火上浇油。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Farage compares standards inquiry to investigations faced by fellow ‘outsider’ Trump
title.zh: 法拉奇将标准调查与“局外人”特朗普的调查相提并论

summary.en: Reform UK leader Nigel Farage has compared his situation to that of Donald Trump, stating both are 'outsiders' facing 'the system.' This comes after scrutiny over his failure to declare a £5 million gift and further financial support from a friend. Farage dismissed the criticism as a sign of a 'complainants' society.'
summary.zh: 英国改革党领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇将自己的处境与唐纳德·特朗普相提并论，称两人都是“局外人”，正在对抗“体制”。此前，他因未能申报一笔500万英镑的捐赠以及一位朋友提供的进一步经济支持而受到审查。法拉奇则将批评斥为“抱怨社会”的迹象。

body.en: Reform UK leader dismisses criticism of his failure to register £5m gift as a sign of a ‘complainants’ society’ Nigel Farage has compared his situation to that of Donald Trump being pursued by investigators for years, saying both of them are “outsiders” up against “the system”, as he admitted having become tetchy and aggrieved this summer. The Reform UK leader has been under huge scrutiny over his finances after failing to declare a £5m gift from the Thailand-based donor Christopher Harborne and further financial support from a friend, the fraudster George Cottrell , before the last election. Continue reading...
body.zh: 改革英国领导人驳斥了对他未能登记500万英镑礼物的批评，认为这是“投诉人”社会的一个迹象。奈杰尔·法拉奇（ Nigel Farage ）将他的情况与唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump ）多年来被调查人员追捕的情况进行了比较，称他们都是“局外人”反对“制度” ，因为他承认今年夏天变得棘手和委屈。在上次选举之前，这位改革英国领导人未能申报泰国捐赠者克里斯托弗·哈伯恩赠送的500万美元£礼物，以及来自欺诈者乔治·科特雷尔（ George Cottrell ）的朋友的进一步财政支持，他的财务状况一直受到严厉审查。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Nigel Farage's comparison to Donald Trump highlights a narrative of being an 'outsider' against 'the system.' This framing can sometimes obscure the need for accountability and transparency. The prophet Micah reminds us that true righteousness involves not just standing against perceived injustices, but actively 'doing justice' and 'loving mercy.'
reflection.zh: 奈杰尔·法拉奇将自己与唐纳德·特朗普相提并论，突显了一种对抗“体制”的“局外人”叙事。这种叙事有时会掩盖对问责和透明度的需求。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的公义不仅在于对抗所谓的や不公，更在于“秉公行义”和“喜爱怜悯”。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: New York City to ban student AI use in public schools until high school
title.zh: 纽约市将在公立学校禁止高中生使用人工智能

summary.en: New York City will ban the use of artificial intelligence by students in public schools up to the eighth grade, citing concerns about 'cognitive surrender.' The policy, set to be announced Wednesday, will also keep students off laptops and tablets until the third grade.
summary.zh: 纽约市将禁止公立学校八年级及以下的学生使用人工智能，理由是担心“认知投降”。该政策定于周三宣布，并将禁止三年级以下的学生使用笔记本电脑或平板电脑。

body.en: Teachers and parents have warned against AI use in schools over concerns of ‘cognitive surrender’ New York City will ban students’ use of artificial intelligence in public schools through eighth grade, typically age 13 or 14. The prohibition is scheduled to be announced Wednesday and will go into effect next week. The change is part of a sweeping overhaul of the use of technology in the US’ largest school district, which enrolls roughly 900,000 students a year. In another policy shift, classrooms will keep students off laptops or tablets through the third grade, age nine or 10. The city’s public school technology policies are closely watched by the rest of the United States. Continue reading...
body.zh: 出于对“认知投降”的担忧，教师和家长警告不要在学校使用人工智能。纽约市将禁止学生在公立学校使用人工智能，直到八年级，通常是13或14岁。禁令定于周三宣布，并将于下周生效。这一变化是美国最大学区对技术使用进行全面改革的一部分，该学区每年招收约90万名学生。在另一项政策转变中，教室将让学生在三年级、9岁或10岁之前不使用笔记本电脑或平板电脑。该市的公立学校技术政策受到美国其他地区的密切关注。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The decision by New York City schools to restrict AI use for younger students highlights a deep concern about how technology shapes the minds of the next generation. This echoes the ancient wisdom of Proverbs, which emphasizes the importance of guiding and instructing children in their formative years. The goal is to ensure that technology serves their...
reflection.zh: 纽约市学校决定限制低年级学生使用人工智能，这凸显了对技术如何塑造下一代心智的深切担忧。这呼应了《箴言》中的古老智慧，强调了在孩子成形的关键时期进行引导和教导的重要性。其目标是确保技术服务于他们的成长，而不是阻碍他们。

verse.textEn: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.
verse.textZh: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。

title.en: Andy Burnham pressed on borrowing costs and spending at first PMQs – UK politics live
title.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆首次面临首相问答，因借贷成本上升——英国政治直播

summary.en: Prime Minister's Questions (PMQs) takes place as the Resolution Foundation suggests it's unrealistic to increase defense spending without raising taxes. Andy Burnham will face his first PMQs today, likely fielding questions from Kemi Badenoch regarding defense spending targets and tax implications.
summary.zh: 英国首相问答（PMQs）之际，分辨率基金会（Resolution Foundation）提出，在不增税的情况下增加国防开支是不切实际的。安迪·伯纳姆（Andy Burnham）今天将面临他的首次首相问答，可能会收到来自凯米·巴登诺赫（Kemi Badenoch）关于国防开支目标和税收影响的问题。

body.en: Burnham faced questions from Kemi Badenoch and other MPs amid speculation over budget In the news release to mark the first anniversary of his election as the Green party’s leader, Zack Polanski highlighted what he described as 10 achievements during his first year in charge. For the record, this is how he sees his record. -Won the Greens’ first ever parliamentary byelection in Gorton and Denton -More than tripled the party membership from 68,500 to over 230,000 Zack Polanski in Holborn and St Pancras sounds like a done deal from the hints the party is dropping over the past 24 hours. Needs the formality of local party sign-off. Our budget for day-to-day spending next year will be lower in real terms than this year. Our capital budget will fall in real terms every year until the end of the decade. Continue reading...
body.zh: PMQ 召开之际，决议基金会表示，认为在不增加税收的情况下增加国防开支是不“现实”的。早上好。安迪·伯纳姆（Andy Burnham）今天将作为总理首次面对 PMQ，但他已经很清楚凯米·巴德诺克（Kemi Badenoch）可能会提出什么问题，因为她昨天已经排练过所有问题。以下是保守党昨天发布的新闻稿的摘录，总结了这些问题以及他们对伯纳姆如何回应的看法。凯米·巴德诺克 (Kemi Badenoch) 询问伯纳姆是否会： - 制定一项计划，将国防开支提高到 GDP 的 3%；继续阅读...

reflection.en: The upcoming Prime Minister's Questions centers on a debate about increasing defense spending, a decision that has significant financial implications for the public. Jeremiah 22:3 reminds leaders of their duty to "execute justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who suffers violence." This calls for careful consideration of...
reflection.zh: 即将到来的首相问答（PMQs）围绕着一项关于增加国防开支的辩论展开，这项决定对公众有着重大的财务影响。《耶利米书》22:3 提醒领导者，他们的职责是“施行公平和公义，拯救被欺压的脱离欺压者的手”。这要求他们仔细考虑此类支出决定如何影响他们所服务的民众的福祉和资源。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Lizzo 'grateful' after judge dismisses lawsuit against production company
title.zh: 莉佐（Lizzo）对制作公司提起诉讼的法官驳回其诉讼表示“感激”

summary.en: Singer Lizzo expressed gratitude after a US district judge dismissed the remaining claims in a lawsuit filed against her production company by a former employee. The lawsuit had alleged various forms of mistreatment.
summary.zh: 美国流行歌星莉佐（Lizzo）在一名前员工对其制作公司提起的诉讼中的剩余指控被美国地方法官驳回后，表示感激。该诉讼曾指控多种形式的虐待。

body.en:
US pop star Lizzo has spoken out after the remaining claims in a lawsuit against her production company were thrown out by a US district judge.

The singer's former wardrobe assistant Asha Daniels alleged she had been subjected to "degradation, forced physical labor, denial of medical care, sexual harassment, and racial harassment" while briefly working for Big Grrrl Big Touring in 2023.

District judge Fernando L Aenlle-Rocha filed a ruling to dismiss the claims by the stylist on Tuesday, according to court documents. , external

In an Instagram post , external , Lizzo said she was "relieved" at the outcome and will "continue to fight" every claim made against her and her company.

In 2024, judge Aenlle-Rocha ruled that Daniels could not sue the Grammy winner as an individual, but Big Grrrl Big Touring Inc remained a defendant.

In his ruling this week, he said the former wardrobe assistant did not identify any conduct by company employees that would demonstrate "general hostility to women in the workplace" or "disparate treatment of men and women".

He also wrote that this alleged conduct and these alleged incidents, "while inappropriate and unprofessional", fell "within the scope of what the Supreme Court has held to be outside the protection" of the "ordinary tribulations of the workplace".

Aenlle-Rocha also responded to an incident in which the stylist claims her foot was run over by a heavy clothes rack.

He wrote that while the court "does not seek to minimise or disregard the pain" felt, the injuries "do not qualify as disabilities" under the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA).

In a statement, Daniels' lawyer Ron Zambrano said they are "disappointed" with the ruling.

"While we respect the court and the judicial process, we believe the decision improperly weighed evidence that should have been evaluated by a jury," he said.

He also noted that they disagree the stylist "twisting her ankle and limping while trying to work does not meet the legal standard of a disability under the ADA".

"These are important issues because these claims often depend on how a jury evaluates the full workplace environment, the surrounding context, and disputed facts," he said.

He added that they "respectfully disagree" with the court's approach and are "considering appropriate next steps".

Following the ruling, the About Damn Time singer, whose real name is Melissa Viviane Jefferson, thanked her lawyers in her Instagram post.

"The truth matters to me more than anything and told y'all I will not settle and will continue to fight every vicious claim that has been made against me and my businesses," she added.

She also wrote that she will continue to use her platform to "spread positivity and light to the world" before signing off by sending love to her...
body.zh: 美国流行歌星Lizzo在针对她的制作公司的诉讼中的剩余索赔被美国地区法官驳回后发表了言论。这位歌手的前衣柜助理阿莎·丹尼尔斯（ Asha Daniels ）声称，她在2023年为Big Grrrl Big Touring短暂工作时遭受了“堕落、强迫体力劳动、拒绝医疗、性骚扰和种族骚扰”。根据法庭文件，地区法官Fernando L Aenlle-Rocha周二作出裁决，驳回造型师的指控。 Lizzo在外部的Instagram帖子中表示，她对结果“松了一口气” ，并将“继续与”对她和她的公司提出的每一项索赔进行斗争。 2024年， Aenlle-Rocha法官裁定Daniels不能以个人身份起诉格莱美奖得主，但Big Grrrl Big Touring Inc仍然是被告。他在本周的裁决中表示，这位前衣柜助理没有发现公司员工的任何行为会表现出“在工作场所对女性的普遍敌意”或“对男性和女性的不同待遇”。他还写道，这种所谓的行为和这些所谓的事件“虽然不恰当且不专业” ，但“在最高法院认为不受保护的范围内” “工作场所的普通苦难”。Aenlle-Rocha还回应了一起事件，造型师声称她的脚被沉重的衣架碾过。他写道，虽然法院“不寻求最大限度地减少或忽视所感受到的痛苦” ，但根据《美国残疾人法》（ ADA ） ，这些伤害“不符合残疾条件”。丹尼尔斯的律师罗恩·赞布拉诺（ Ron Zambrano ）在一份声明中表示，他们对这一裁决感到“失望”。“虽然我们尊重法院和司法程序，但我们认为该决定不恰当地权衡了本应由陪审团评估的证据，”他说。他还指出，他们不同意造型师“在努力工作时扭伤脚踝和跛行不符合ADA规定的残疾法律标准”。他说： “这些都是重要的问题，因为这些主张通常取决于陪审团如何评估整个工作场所环境、周围环境和有争议的事实。”他补充说，他们“尊重地不同意”法院的做法，并“正在考虑适当的后续步骤”。裁决之后，真名为梅丽莎·薇薇安·杰斐逊（ Melissa Viviane Jefferson ）的《关于该死的时间》（ About Damn Time ）歌手在她的Instagram帖子中感谢了她的律师她补充说： “对我来说，真相比任何事情都重要，并告诉你们，我不会妥协，并将继续与针对我和我的企业提出的每一项恶意索赔作斗争。”她还写道，在通过向她发送爱来签署之前，她将继续使用她的平台“向世界传播积极性和光明”......

reflection.en: In legal and public disputes, it is easy for narratives to become one-sided, especially when amplified by media. Proverbs 18:17 reminds us that "the first to present his case seems right, so his opponent can reveal the truth." This case, with its dismissal of claims, illustrates how a fuller hearing can bring clarity, even if the initial accusations gained...
reflection.zh: 在法律和公众纠纷中，叙事很容易变得片面，尤其是在媒体的放大作用下。《箴言》18:17 提醒我们：“先诉的显为有理，及至对手来到，就显出别情。”此案的指控被驳回，说明了充分的审理可以带来清晰，即使最初的指控获得了广泛关注。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: Iran accuses US of ‘war crime’ after missile blast kills four people at wedding
title.zh: 伊朗指控美国犯下“战争罪”，导弹爆炸造成四人死亡，婚礼现场血案

summary.en: Iran has accused the United States of committing a war crime after a missile strike killed at least four people and injured 68 others attending a wedding in the southern Iranian city of Kuhestak. The incident has raised fears of a wider escalation of hostilities in the region.
summary.zh: 伊朗指控美国犯下战争罪，此前一枚导弹袭击造成至少四人死亡，另有68人受伤，当时他们正在伊朗南部城市库赫塔克参加一场婚礼。此次事件引发了对该地区敌对行动可能进一步升级的担忧。

body.en: Blast also injures 68 guests at the wedding in southern Iran, prompting fears of escalation in hostilities Middle East crisis live – latest updates Iran has accused the US of a war crime after a missile blast killed at least four people and injured 68 who were attending a wedding at a private home in a coastal city of southern Iran, as the fresh exchange of strikes prompted fears of a wider renewal of hostilities. Iranian media said that the wedding ceremony was being held in a home in the city of Kuhestak, Hormozgan province, late on Tuesday when a US missile struck, with shrapnel and debris from the strike killing and injuring people. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在伊朗南部举行的婚礼上，爆炸还造成68名客人受伤，引发了对敌对行动升级的担忧中东危机现场–最新消息伊朗指责美国犯有战争罪，此前导弹爆炸造成至少4人死亡， 68人受伤，当时他们正在伊朗南部沿海城市的一个私人住宅参加婚礼，因为新的罢工引发了对更广泛敌对行动的担忧。伊朗媒体称，婚礼于周二晚些时候在霍尔木兹甘省库切斯塔克市的一所房屋举行，当时一枚美国导弹击中了袭击造成人员伤亡的弹片和碎片。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of a missile strike killing wedding guests in Iran, leading to accusations of war crimes, underscores the tragic human cost of escalating conflict. In such moments, the call to be peacemakers, to actively seek reconciliation rather than fueling further retaliation, resonates deeply. May we pray for wisdom and restraint for all parties involved,...
reflection.zh: 伊朗婚礼现场导弹袭击造成宾客伤亡，并引发战争罪指控的消息，凸显了冲突升级带来的悲惨人道代价。在这样的时刻，成为和平之子、积极寻求和解而非加剧报复循环的呼召，显得尤为重要。愿我们为所有相关方祈求智慧与克制，使暴力循环得以打破。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: US sanctions halt TOEFL and GRE tests in Iran, disrupting study plans
title.zh: 美国制裁叫停伊朗托福和GRE考试，打乱留学计划

summary.en: Students in Iran are unable to take TOEFL and GRE exams due to the suspension of a US sanctions exemption. Applicants report that this decision jeopardizes their university application deadlines and imposes costly travel requirements.
summary.zh: 由于美国制裁豁免被暂停，伊朗学生无法参加托福和GRE考试。申请者表示，此举威胁到他们的大学申请截止日期，并增加了昂贵的旅行负担。

body.en:
Students in Iran can no longer take TOEFL and GRE exams after a US sanctions exemption was suspended. Applicants say the move threatens university deadlines and adds costly travel obligations.

Iranian students hoping to study abroad are facing a new obstacle after TOEFL and GRE testing was suspended inside the country following changes to US sanctions regulations .

"My entire plan was built around taking this exam," a TOEFL candidate in Tehran told DW. She said she had spent months preparing applications for a PhD program, contacting professors and gathering documents despite internet disruptions and other challenges.

ETS, the US-based organization that administers both exams, announced it suspended testing in Iran after the US Treasury Department's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) froze General License G, which had allowed certain educational services to continue in Iran .

"Following OFAC's suspension of General License G, ETS has paused administration of the TOEFL and GRE tests in Iran effective immediately," the organization said in an official notice.

ETS added that Iranian nationals can still take the exams outside Iran and that it is exploring options to restore testing.

TOEFL is a US-based English-language proficiency test accepted by universities worldwide. The GRE, also administered by the same US organization, is a standardized test required by some graduate programs, particularly in the United States and Canada.

Since the  Iran war  began in late February, the US has increasingly expanded sanctions targeting Iranian trade and exports, contributing to broader disruptions throughout the Iranian economy .

An Iranian institution that administered TOEFL exams told DW that new registrations had stopped following the latest sanctions changes .

The institution added that the suspension could be temporary, but no date had been given for exams to resume.

That uncertainty is particularly serious for students approaching university and scholarship deadlines who have spent months preparing documents, contacting professors and paying application-related costs.

The suspension follows earlier problems with IELTS (British equivalent of TOEFL) testing in Iran. An IELTS center in Tehran  told DW that sanctions-related difficulties transferring money had become one of the main obstacles to continuing exams.

Some Iranian applicants had already been traveling to countries such as Turkey and Armenia to take IELTS. TOEFL and GRE candidates may now have to do the same.

Alireza, who is preparing to apply to a university in Italy, said the suspension of TOEFL had disrupted a backup plan he had arranged after IELTS testing became unavailable.

"European universities usually accept IELTS. But because IELTS has been suspended in...
body.zh: 在美国制裁豁免暂停后，伊朗的学生不能再参加托福和GRE考试。申请人表示，此举威胁到大学的最后期限，并增加了昂贵的旅行义务。希望出国留学的伊朗学生在美国制裁法规变更后，托福和GRE考试在国内暂停后面临新的障碍。“我的整个计划都是围绕着参加这次考试制定的，”德黑兰的一名托福考生告诉DW。她说，尽管互联网中断和其他挑战，她还是花了几个月的时间准备博士学位课程的申请，联系教授并收集文件。管理这两项考试的美国组织ETS宣布，在美国财政部外国资产控制办公室（ OFAC ）冻结通用许可证G后，它暂停了在伊朗的考试，该许可证允许某些教育服务继续在伊朗进行。“在OFAC暂停通用许可证G之后， ETS已暂停在伊朗进行托福和GRE考试，立即生效，”该组织在一份官方通知中表示。ETS补充说，伊朗国民仍然可以在伊朗境外参加考试，并且正在探索恢复测试的选项。托福是全球各大学接受的美国英语水平考试。GRE也由同一个美国组织管理，是一些研究生课程要求的标准化考试，特别是在美国和加拿大。自2月下旬伊朗战争开始以来，美国越来越多地扩大针对伊朗贸易和出口的制裁，导致整个伊朗经济出现更广泛的混乱。一家管理托福考试的伊朗机构告诉德国之声，在最近的制裁变更后，新的注册已经停止。该机构补充说，暂停考试可能是暂时的，但没有给出恢复考试的日期。对于接近大学和奖学金截止日期的学生来说，这种不确定性尤其严重，他们花了数月时间准备文件，联系教授并支付与申请相关的费用。此前，伊朗雅思（英国相当于托福）考试出现了问题。德黑兰雅思考试中心告诉德国之声，与制裁有关的转账困难已成为继续考试的主要障碍之一。一些伊朗申请人已经前往土耳其和亚美尼亚等国家参加雅思考试。托福和GRE考生现在可能必须做同样的事情。准备申请意大利一所大学的Alireza表示，暂停托福考试打乱了他在雅思考试不可用后安排的备考计划。“欧洲大学通常接受雅思考试。但由于雅思考试已被暂停...

reflection.en: The suspension of TOEFL and GRE tests in Iran, a consequence of US sanctions, leaves many students in a difficult position, threatening their academic timelines and forcing them to incur additional expenses. These students, who have worked diligently to prepare their applications, find their voices unheard and their futures uncertain due to decisions made...
reflection.zh: 美国制裁暂停了伊朗的托福和GRE考试，这使得许多学生陷入困境，威胁到他们的学业时间表，并迫使他们承担额外费用。这些学生辛勤准备申请材料，却发现自己的声音被忽视，未来变得不确定，这一切都源于远方的决定。《箴言》31:8-9呼吁我们“为不能说话的开口，为所有孤苦者辨明是非”。这段经文提醒我们要为那些机会受到不公正限制的人们发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Tiger Woods gets five-year driving ban after reckless driving plea
title.zh: 泰格·伍兹因鲁莽驾驶认罪，被判五年禁驾

summary.en: Golfer Tiger Woods has agreed to a five-year driving ban and a $1,000 fine as part of a plea deal, reducing an initial charge of driving under the influence following a rollover crash in Florida.
summary.zh: 高尔夫球手泰格·伍兹已同意接受五年禁驾和1000美元的罚款，作为一项认罪协议的一部分，该协议将佛罗里达州翻车事故后的酒驾初犯指控降级。

body.en:
Tiger Woods has agreed not to contest a reckless driving charge as part of a deal with prosecutors, reducing the original charge of driving under the influence from a rollover crash in Florida.

The golfer accepted a five-year suspension of his driving licence and a $1,000 (£742) fine, as part of a plea agreement with prosecutors in Martin County, Florida.

Woods was arrested after the March crash, and had passed a breathalyser test but declined further testing for other drugs.

He pleaded not guilty the same month to misdemeanor charges of driving under the influence and refusal to submit to testing. Woods, 50, said he was seeking treatment after the incident.

"I'm completely confident and comfortable with the resolution of this case," Florida State Attorney Thomas Bakkedahl said at a press conference after the hearing.

"Today I resolved case involving a man who drives a golf ball for a living," Bakkedahl said. "Tomorrow, I'll resolve a case in the same matter for a man who drives a nail for a living."

No one was injured in the crash, though Woods had to crawl out through the passenger door to free himself.

Police released body camera footage in April that captured the aftermath of the incident, showing the golfing legend after his vehicle clipped a truck and rolled over.

In the video, Woods appears calm, kneeling on one knee as he tells officers: "I looked down at my phone, and all of a sudden, boom".

He passed a breathalyser test but declined to take a urinalysis screening for other drugs, Martin County Sheriff John Budensiek said at the time.

Woods told officers he had not consumed alcohol that day. When asked about any prescription medication, he responded, "I take a few", adding he had done so earlier that morning.

Officers told Woods they suspected his "normal faculties" were impaired by an "unknown substance".

Authorities later reported finding two white pills in his pocket, identified as hydrocodone, an opioid commonly prescribed to treat pain.

Woods wrote on social media following the incident, "I know and understand the seriousness of the situation I find myself in today.

"I am stepping away for a period of time to seek treatment and focus on my health. This is necessary in order for me to prioritise my wellbeing and work toward lasting recovery."

The incident marked Woods' second arrest on suspicion of driving under the influence.
body.zh: 作为与检察官达成协议的一部分，老虎伍兹已同意不对鲁莽的驾驶指控提出异议，从而减少了在佛罗里达州发生的翻车事故的影响下驾驶的原始指控。作为与佛罗里达州马丁县检察官达成的认罪协议的一部分，这位高尔夫球手接受了为期五年的驾驶执照吊销和1000美元（ 742英镑）的罚款。伍兹在3月坠机后被捕，并通过了呼吸分析仪测试，但拒绝进一步测试其他药物。同月，他对受影响驾驶和拒绝接受测试的轻罪指控表示不认罪。50岁的伍兹说，他在事件发生后正在寻求治疗。佛罗里达州检察官托马斯·巴克达尔（ Thomas Bakkedahl ）在听证会后的新闻发布会上说： “我对这起案件的解决完全有信心和满意。” “今天我解决了一个以开高尔夫球为生的男人的案子，” Bakkedahl说。“明天，我将为一个以开钉子为生的人解决同一个案件。” 车祸中没有人受伤，尽管伍兹不得不从乘客门爬出来解救自己。 警方在4月份发布了身体摄像头镜头，捕捉了事件的后果，显示了他的车辆夹住一辆卡车并翻身后的高尔夫传奇。在视频中，伍兹显得平静，单膝跪地告诉警官： “我低头看着我的手机，突然，砰的一声。”马丁县警长John Budensiek当时表示，他通过了酒精分析仪测试，但拒绝接受其他药物的尿液分析筛查。伍兹告诉警官，他那天没有喝酒。当被问及任何处方药时，他回答说： “我吃了一些” ，并补充说他当天早上早些时候已经这样做了。官员告诉伍兹，他们怀疑他的“正常能力”受到“未知物质”的损害。当局后来报告说，在他的口袋里发现了两颗白色药丸，被确定为氢可酮，一种通常用于治疗疼痛的阿片类药物。事件发生后，伍兹在社交媒体上写道： “我知道并理解我今天所处的情况的严重性。“我要离开一段时间，寻求治疗，专注于自己的健康。这是我优先考虑自己的健康和努力实现持久康复所必需的。” 这起事件标志着伍兹因涉嫌在酒后驾车而第二次被捕。

reflection.en: Fame and talent can bring great success, but they do not shield individuals from the consequences of poor decisions. Tiger Woods's legal troubles serve as a stark reminder that even those at the pinnacle of their careers are subject to the same laws and moral accountability. This situation calls us to reflect on the importance of humility and sound...
reflection.zh: 名望和才华可以带来巨大的成功，但它们并不能使个人免受不良决定带来的后果。泰格·伍兹的法律困境是一个严峻的提醒，即使是处于职业生涯巅峰的人，也同样受到法律和道德责任的约束。这种情况促使我们反思谦卑和审慎判断的重要性，无论个人的公众地位如何。

verse.textEn: Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall.
verse.textZh: 骄傲在败坏以先；狂心在跌倒之前。

title.en: EU and Nato vow to step up pressure on Russia after 'new escalation' in Germany
title.zh: 欧盟和北约誓言在德国“新升级”后加大对俄压力

summary.en: Following Germany's accusation of Russia for a failed drone attack on Leipzig airport, NATO and the European Commission have warned of Russia's increasing recklessness and pledged to respond faster and better to a 'new normal' of escalation on EU soil.
summary.zh: 在德国指控俄罗斯发动了对莱比锡机场的无人机袭击失败后，北约和欧盟委员会警告俄罗斯日益鲁莽，并誓言要更快、更好地应对欧盟领土上“新常态”的升级。

body.en:
The heads of Nato and the European Commission have warned that Russia is growing increasingly reckless and vowed to respond to a "new normal".

"Leipzig marks a new escalation on European Union soil directly attributed to Russia," said Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, a day after Germany blamed Russia for a failed drone attack last month on Leipzig airport.

"We have to step up and that means being ready to respond to Russia's recklessness faster and better," von der Leyen said. Nato Secretary General Mark Rutte said the whole alliance, which includes the US, stood "in full solidarity with Germany".

Russia has rejected German accusations that a drone carrying explosives deliberately targeted a Ukrainian cargo plane on 4 August.

The drone was defused by a robot at Leipzig/Halle airport and a second drone is thought to have collided with another cargo plane.

A third drone was reportedly found 10 days later at the airport, which is an important Nato hub and is regularly used by Ukrainian Antonov transport aircraft.

It was not until Tuesday that the German government said police investigations and intelligence finding had proved that Russia was behind the incidents.

The interior minister said that the drone's configuration, components, explosives and detonator were all known from other Russian hybrid operations.

Two suspects have reportedly been identified in the Leipzig attack, including a Belarusian with a Russian passport who entered on a tourist visa, and another with Latvian and Russian passports who arrived by plane in Berlin and flew out two days before the failed attack.

Berlin has said it will close the Russian consulate in Bonn as well as the Russian House cultural institution, widely suspected in Berlin of acting as a propaganda outlet for the Kremlin.

The Russian foreign ministry promised to respond in "mirror-image" fashion and said Berlin had offered no evidence to back its claims.

Vladimir Putin has condemned Germany's measures as a serious mistake that "clearly runs counter to the interests of the German people".

Asked whether Moscow would be prepared to sever relations with Berlin, Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Alexander Grushko said "maybe", but for now it was giving diplomacy a chance.

Critics in Germany suggested the German response was relatively weak, but Berlin has its eye on a more co-ordinated response with its allies, including extended EU sanctions and entry restrictions on Russian visitors across the bloc.

Von der Leyen was clear in her statement that the Leipzig attack had involved "military-grade material carried out by Russian operatives on European Union soil".

While she was meeting Rutte in Brussels, EU foreign ministers had gathered at Wicklow in Ireland, where France's Foreign Minister...

reflection.en: The escalating tensions between Russia and the EU, marked by the Leipzig drone incident, present a stark reminder of the fragility of peace. The call to 'step up' and respond to 'recklessness' underscores the difficult path of navigating conflict while striving for diplomatic solutions. May wisdom guide leaders toward de-escalation and the pursuit of...
reflection.zh: 俄罗斯与欧盟之间日益紧张的局势，以莱比锡无人机事件为标志，严峻地提醒着和平的脆弱性。“加大应对”和回应“鲁莽行为”的呼吁，凸显了在寻求外交解决方案的同时，应对冲突的艰难道路。愿智慧引导领导者走向缓和局势，追求持久和平，而非进一步陷入敌对。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Guinea-Bissau referendum tests democratic future
title.zh: 几内亚比绍公投考验民主未来

summary.en: Following voter approval of a constitutional change that expands presidential powers, Guinea-Bissau faces renewed debate over legitimacy, civilian rule and democratic safeguards.
summary.zh: 在选民批准了一项扩大总统权力的宪法修正案后，几内亚比绍面临着关于合法性、文官统治和民主保障的新一轮辩论。

body.en:
Following voter approval of a constitutional change that expands presidential powers, Guinea-Bissau faces renewed debate over legitimacy, civilian rule and democratic safeguards.

Guinea-Bissau is facing a new political test after voters approved a referendum on a proposed charter that will give the president the power to appoint and dismiss the prime minister and government ministers, while reducing the number of seats in parliament from 102 to 65..

Sunday's referendum came less than 10 months after a coup in which the military seized power and three months ahead of presidential and parliamentary elections scheduled to take place on December 6.

The transitional authorities say the constitutional reform is intended to bring stability to the impoverished West African country and prepare it for a return to civilian rule.

On Monday, the National Transitional Council claimed victory for the "Yes" camp. "The majority of those who went to vote voted yes. In conclusion, the victory of yes is guaranteed," council spokesman Alberto Pinto Pereira said.

On Tuesday, the National Electoral Commission (NEC) confirmed victory for the "Yes" side, saying it had received 70% of the vote, compared with 30% for the "No" camp, and that voter turnout exceeded 50%.

NEC chairperson Carmen Izaura Lobo described the Guinea-Bissau referendum as a success, due to the "organizational capacity, professionalism and dedication" of teams on the ground, Agence France-Presse (AFP) reported.

The opposition, however, says the referendum has no legal basis because it was organized by institutions created after the military coup . It had called on voters to boycott the vote.

Domingos Simoes Pereira, leader of the African Party for the Independence of Guinea and Cape Verde (PAIGC), who was  detained after the military coup and later released into house arrest , rejected the referendum as legally invalid.

Speaking to DW from Portugal, he said the institutions established by the military have no democratic mandate to rewrite Guinea-Bissau's constitution.

The PAIGC and other opposition groups maintain that the vote is a continuation of the November coup.

Fernando Dias Costa, the main challenger to then-President Umaro Sissoco Embalo in the November 2025 presidential election that was annulled by the military, disputed the official turnout figures.

"Very few citizens took part in this referendum," he said, noting that the people have sent an important message that must not be ignored.

"They are not prepared to simply accept political changes that are clearly unconstitutional and have not been publicly debated."

The proposed constitution would move Guinea-Bissau toward a much stronger presidential system. The president would appoint and dismiss the prime minister and...

reflection.en: Guinea-Bissau's recent referendum, which shifts power towards the presidency by reducing parliamentary seats and granting the president authority over ministerial appointments, raises concerns about democratic safeguards. Proverbs 29:2 reminds us that the stability and well-being of a nation are deeply tied to the character and actions of its rulers, urging...
reflection.zh: 几内亚比绍最近的公投，通过减少议会席位并授予总统任命部长的权力，将权力向总统转移，这引发了对民主保障的担忧。《箴言》29:2提醒我们，国家的稳定和福祉与其统治者的品格和行为息息相关，因此需要警惕权力的平衡和对文官统治的保护。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: India rejects Hague ruling on Indus waters: What's next?
title.zh: 印度驳回海牙裁决，下一步是什么？

summary.en: India has rejected a ruling by an international arbitration panel regarding the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty, casting doubt on the treaty's future. New Delhi described the tribunal as a "so-called Court of Arbitration" that was "illegally constituted."
summary.zh: 印度驳回了国际仲裁小组关于1960年《印度河流域条约》的裁决，这给该条约的未来蒙上了阴影。新德里称该仲裁庭为“所谓的仲裁法院”，并称其“非法组成”。

body.en:
By rejecting an international arbitration panel's ruling, New Delhi has cast fresh doubt on the future of the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty.

The Indus Waters Treaty is facing a fresh dispute after India rejected a Hague-based Court of Arbitration ruling that the 1960 agreement remains in force.   

India's Ministry of External Affairs described the tribunal as a "so-called Court of Arbitration" that was "illegally constituted."

It said the body had been established by the World Bank in breach of the treaty and that India "categorically rejects its so-called award, just as it has firmly rejected all prior pronouncements by this illegally constituted body."

"The Court of Arbitration has no jurisdiction whatsoever to pronounce on India's sovereign decisions," the ministry said.

The Indus Waters Treaty, brokered by the World Bank, governs the use of water from six rivers flowing through India and Pakistan.

The agreement largely gives India rights over three eastern rivers while Pakistan has rights over the western Indus, Jhelum and Chenab. India is allowed to use the western rivers for specified purposes including certain hydroelectric projects.

The treaty had endured wars and prolonged periods of intense hostility between the two nuclear-armed neighbors.

But India placed the treaty in abeyance in April 2025 as part of a package of diplomatic and economic measures announced after a deadly attack in India-administered Kashmir killed 26 people, mostly tourists.

Millions of people in Pakistan depend on the Indus, Jhelum and Chenab rivers for drinking water, farming and daily life.

The rivers are particularly important to Punjab and Sindh provinces, whose agriculture is central to the country's food supply and rural economy.

After India's move to suspend the treaty, Pakistan approached the court in The Hague over the status of the accord.

Pakistani officials have repeatedly warned that any attempt to deny the country its share of the waters of rivers flowing across the border would be treated as an act of war.

Ajay Bisaria, a former Indian high commissioner to Pakistan, said India had challenged the treaty on both political and legal grounds.

"Politically, abeyance hands India a new point of leverage, one more lever to press Pakistan into changing its behavior on cross-border terrorism," Bisaria told DW.

He also pointed to India's earlier requests to renegotiate the treaty, citing climate change, new dam-building technology and the deterioration of relations between the two countries.

India chose to put the treaty in abeyance rather than formally abrogate it. Bisaria said the Hague ruling would not change that course.

"The tribunal will not alter this trajectory," he said. "India's course on the Indus Waters Treaty is set. The...

reflection.en: The future of the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty is uncertain after India rejected an international arbitration ruling, calling the tribunal "illegally constituted." This stance raises questions about how nations can navigate disputes and maintain treaties when fundamental disagreements arise about the process itself. The call to "live at peace with everyone, if...
reflection.zh: 在印度拒绝一项国际仲裁裁决并称该仲裁庭“非法组成”之后，1960年《印度河流域条约》的未来变得不确定。这一立场引发了关于当国家在程序本身上存在根本分歧时，如何处理争端和维持条约的疑问。“若可行，总要尽力与众人和睦”（罗马书12:18）这节经文提醒我们，即使在信任受到考验时，也要寻求对话和解决的途径。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Nepal intensifies relief and recovery efforts after deadly floods, UN says
title.zh: 尼泊尔在联合国称，致命洪水后加强救济和恢复工作

summary.en: More than 1,000 people have died and thousands are missing, as rescue efforts continue and aid is airlifted to villages.
summary.zh: 随着救援工作的继续和援助物资被空运到村庄，已有1000多人死亡，数千人失踪。

body.en:
Nepal is intensifying relief and recovery operations following the catastrophic flash floods along the Nepal-Tibet border a week ago, the UN says, even as rescuers scramble to reach anyone who may be alive.

For thousands, the priority is delivering aid, recovering loved ones, tracing missing relatives and reunifying separated children, the UN secretary-general's spokesman said.

At least 1,114 people have died in Nepal and nearly 4,000 more are missing, according to Nepal's disaster agency. On the Tibetan side, the death toll is 21, with more than 540 people unaccounted for, Chinese state media report.

Efforts are continuing to rescue workers, potentially in the hundreds, believed to be trapped in Nepalese hydropower tunnels.

A massive flash flood, believed to have been triggered by a glacial collapse, swept through a Himalayan valley last Wednesday, wiping out villages.

Nearly 12,000 people have since been rescued, according to Nepal's disaster management agency.

But thousands more, including hundreds of foreign nationals - from India, the UK, Australia, the US, Malaysia and more - are still missing. A week on, fears are growing that the death toll will only rise.

Chinese rescue teams are continuing to search for more than 500 people missing on the Tibetan side of the border, but they have yet to find survivors at the crossing known as Gyirong Port between Nepal and Tibet.

Beijing, which annexed Tibet in the 1950s, tightly controls the region. All information comes from state media and foreign journalists cannot travel there without permission.

Rescuers using heavy machinery, working around the clock, have been able to re-open the route to the Gyirong border crossing and clear the road of debris, which will accelerate the search for the missing, Chinese state media said.

Rescue operations continue in challenging conditions, and experts from China and India are helping build temporary bridges to reach remote areas. Drones are being deployed over hard-to reach areas to scan for survivors.

The UN's Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) says the main challenge is access, with more than 40 bridges destroyed.

The most remote communities are relying on army helicopter flights for supplies, and villages are still struggling for fuel and electricity.

The full impact of the flood in Tibet is unclear. China has released information through state media outlets showing the devastation around the border, but has given few details about the victims or the impact on local villagers.

In Nepal, nearly 3,500 people have been left homeless and displaced in 27 sites - mostly schools, which disrupts education - across the districts of Nuwakot and Rasuwa.

People packed into overcrowded shelters, contaminated water and damaged health...

reflection.en: In the wake of devastating floods that have claimed over a thousand lives and left thousands more missing, Nepal is intensifying relief efforts. The UN reports that the priority for many is delivering aid, recovering loved ones, and reuniting separated children. This immense task calls us to remember Jesus' words, 'Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one...
reflection.zh: 在造成一千多人死亡、数千人失踪的毁灭性洪水之后，尼泊尔正在加紧救济工作。联合国报道称，许多人的当务之急是运送援助物资、寻找亲人遗体以及让失散的儿童团聚。这项艰巨的任务提醒我们耶稣的话：“我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。”

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: Zelensky says airlines should avoid Russian airspace as Ukraine escalates drone operations
title.zh: 泽连斯基称航空公司应避开俄领空，乌克兰升级无人机行动

summary.en: Ukraine's president has urged airlines to avoid Russian airspace, stating it is becoming 'completely dangerous' as Ukraine escalates its drone operations. This comes as Russia has vowed to intensify its own attacks on Ukraine, with Chinese and Gulf state airlines still using Russian airspace.
summary.zh: 乌克兰总统敦促航空公司避开俄罗斯领空，称随着乌克兰升级无人机行动，俄罗斯领空正变得“完全危险”。此前，俄罗斯已誓言要加强其对乌克兰的袭击，而中国和海湾国家的航空公司仍在继续使用俄罗斯领空。

body.en:
Ukraine's president has told airlines that Russian airspace will be "effectively closing" as his country escalates its drone strikes.

"We want to warn every airline that uses Russian airspace, every insurer, everyone who still uses key Russian airports: the Russian sky is becoming completely dangerous," Volodymyr Zelensky said. Ukraine has since formally notified the UN of the risks to civilian aviation.

Russian President Vladimir Putin said the comments amounted to a "declaration of state terrorism".

Most Western commercial airlines do not fly over Russia because of the ongoing Russian invasion of Ukraine, but carriers in countries like Turkey and China do.

Explaining the elevated airspace risk in his nightly video address on Tuesday, Zelensky said that "Ukraine does not threaten civilian aviation as such - not a single civilian aircraft" and did not want the loss of innocent lives.

"There will simply be drones in Russia's skies on a scale that has to be taken into account," he said.

Zelensky directed the warning to airlines continuing to operate flights to Russian airports, especially in major cities like St Petersburg and Moscow.

In a statement on X, Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said that Ukraine had officially notified the International Civil Aviation Organization that Russian airspace was not safe for civilian aviation.

"We want to prevent unintended incidents," he said, adding: "The war is returning home to Russia."

On Wednesday afternoon, flight tracking website FlightRadar24 showed many planes flying over Russia, including arriving and departing from the two main airports.

Several airlines that fly through Russia told the BBC that they were carefully monitoring the situation.

Qatar Airways, which flies into Moscow and travels through Russian airspace to get to the US west coast, said its flight planning was "guided by rigorous and continuous monitoring of airspace security, safety assessments, and geopolitical developments".

FlyDubai, an Emirati government-owned carrier, told the BBC that it would "closely monitor the evolving situation in the region and adjust our flight schedules and routings as necessary".

Ukraine has targeted energy facilities deep inside Russian territory and there have been repeated attacks on depots belonging to Russia's two biggest online retailers, Wildberries and Ozon.

Its drone attacks have for months led to disruption at some of Russia's biggest airports, especially in Moscow where at times all four major airports have been forced to halt arrivals and departures.

Under Russia's air defence "Kovyor" (carpet) plan, flights are suspended if a drone is detected in the relevant area.

Aviation risk advisory firm Osprey Flight Solutions said in an alert to clients that while the majority of Ukraine's...

reflection.en: The escalating drone operations and warnings about Russian airspace paint a grim picture of a conflict deepening its cycle of retaliation. As President Zelensky declares Russian skies 'completely dangerous,' the world watches nations caught in a spiral of action and counter-action. May wisdom prevail over the impulse to meet violence with further violence,...
reflection.zh: 无人机行动的升级和对俄罗斯领空的警告，描绘了一幅冲突加剧报复循环的严峻图景。当泽连斯基总统宣布俄罗斯领空“完全危险”时，世界正注视着被行动与反行动的漩涡所困的国家。愿智慧胜过以暴力回应暴力的冲动，转而寻求缓和局势与和平的道路。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Armed men abduct Kenyan editor, employer suspects government
title.zh: 武装人员绑架肯尼亚编辑，雇主怀疑政府所为

summary.en: A newspaper editor in Kenya was abducted by armed men late on Tuesday and found hours later near a dam. His employer, The Standard, suspects state involvement aimed at intimidating reporters.
summary.zh: 肯尼亚一家报社的编辑周二晚间遭武装人员绑架，数小时后在水坝附近被发现。他的雇主《标准报》怀疑此举是政府为恐吓记者所为。

reflection.en: The abduction of Alex Kiprotich, and the suspicion that state actors were involved, raises profound questions about the role of government. Jeremiah 22:3 reminds leaders that their primary duty is to execute justice and righteousness, protecting the vulnerable, not intimidating them.
reflection.zh: 亚历克斯·基普罗蒂奇的绑架事件，以及人们怀疑是国家行为者所为，引发了关于政府角色的深刻问题。耶利米书22:3提醒领导者，他们的首要职责是施行公正和公义，保护弱者，而不是恐吓他们。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: The shifting ties in Australia's backyard as 'deep pockets' beckon
title.zh: 澳大利亚后院的变动关系：‘深口袋’的诱惑

summary.en: While China stirs tensions over Taiwan in Palau, island leaders are urging Canberra to focus on climate and drug crime.
summary.zh: 在中国试图在帕劳挑起关于台湾的紧张局势之际，岛屿领导人正敦促堪培拉关注气候变化和毒品犯罪。

body.en:
China and Taiwan's diplomatic tug-of-war is casting a shadow over the ongoing Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) as a handful of national leaders declined to attend — however, experts on the ground caution that a geopolitical focus risks ignoring the core priorities of Australia's neighbours.

The annual 18-member gathering in the Taiwanese-allied nation of Palau opened on Monday with climate change, economic security, and the rising influence of the transnational drug trade top of the agenda.

China has said it has "serious concerns" that Taiwan was invited to attend in its own right, while questions have been raised about whether China has influenced five of 18 national leaders from the forum (those of Kiribati, Fiji, Vanuatu, Samoa and Solomon Island) not to attend.

The cornerstone regional political forum began this year with a pointed message from Palau's President Surangel Whipps Jr, who urged nations to adhere to this year's theme of unity and reminded outside partners that they "do not choose our destination".

This year's PIF takes place as Kiribati moves to constitutionally restrict diplomatic recognition to UN member states only — thus excluding Taiwan — while China actively seeks to strip Taiwan of its 'development partner' status in the forum. This comes nearly two months after a Chinese ballistic missile test in the Pacific Ocean .

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Taiwan, a self-governing democracy, broke away from mainland China in 1949. China views it as Chinese territory that must be brought under its control by force if necessary.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has made strengthening regional ties a key focus of his administration's foreign policy, signing multiple bilateral agreements with countries like Fiji, Vanuatu, and Tuvalu.

But despite the noise around China, "leaders have made it clear they're here to work" Tess Newton Cain, principal consultant at Asia-Pacific strategic firm Sustineo, told SBS News from Koror.

"The issue of the China-Taiwan tussle is largely a distraction, and one that they try to minimise."

On Wednesday, $600 million in Australian funding was announced to tackle transnational drug smuggling from South America that is increasingly causing harm across the Pacific.

China has made the PIF something of a battleground, maintaining that Taiwan ought to be sidelined during talks, as it is not technically a "dialogue partner" due to a difficult compromise that PIF members have reached over its status for the past three decades.

Palau, one of the few nations that maintains official diplomatic ties with Taiwan, has accused China of running a coercion campaign against it after travel...
body.zh: 由于少数国家领导人拒绝出席，中国和台湾的外交拉锯战给正在进行的太平洋岛屿论坛（PIF）蒙上了阴影。然而，现场专家警告称，地缘政治焦点可能会忽视澳大利亚邻国的核心优先事项。 一年一度的 18 名成员聚会于周一在台湾盟友帕劳开幕，气候变化、经济安全和跨国毒品贸易影响力不断上升成为首要议题。 中国表示，它“严重关切”台湾本身受邀参加，同时也有人质疑中国是否影响论坛 18 个国家领导人中的 5 个（基里巴斯、斐济、瓦努阿图、萨摩亚和所罗门群岛）不参加。 这一基石区域政治论坛于今年拉开帷幕，帕劳总统小苏兰吉尔·惠普斯发出了尖锐的信息，他敦促各国坚持今年的团结主题，并提醒外部伙伴“我们的目的地不是他们选择的”。 今年的PIF召开之际，基里巴斯从宪法上采取行动，限制仅对联合国成员国进行外交承认，从而将台湾排除在外，而中国则积极寻求剥夺台湾在论坛中的“发展伙伴”地位。这是中国在太平洋进行弹道导弹试验近两个月后的事。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 台湾是一个自治民主国家，于 1949 年脱离中国大陆。中国将其视为中国领土，必要时必须使用武力将其置于其控制之下。 安东尼·阿尔巴内塞总理将加强区域关系作为其政府外交政策的重点，与斐济、瓦努阿图和图瓦卢等国签署了多项双边协议。 不过，尽管中国周围一片喧嚣，“领导人已经明确表示，他们来这里是为了工作”，亚太战略公司 Sustineo 的首席顾问泰丝·牛顿·凯恩 (Tess Newton Cain) 在科罗尔告诉 SBS 新闻。 “中国与台湾的争斗问题在很大程度上是一种干扰，他们试图将其最小化。” 周三，澳大利亚宣布提供 6 亿美元资金，用于打击来自南美洲的跨国毒品走私，这种走私在太平洋沿岸造成的危害日益严重。 中国已将太平洋岛礁论坛变成了一个战场，坚持认为台湾应该在谈判中靠边站，因为过去三十年来，太平洋岛礁论坛成员就其地位达成了艰难的妥协，因此从技术上讲，台湾并不是“对话伙伴”。 帕劳是少数几个与台湾保持正式外交关系的国家之一，该国指责中国在旅行后对其进行胁迫行动......

reflection.en: The leaders of Pacific island nations are navigating complex geopolitical currents, yet their urgent pleas to Australia highlight their immediate concerns: climate change and the drug trade. These are matters of justice and well-being for their people, echoing the prophet Micah's call to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Yahweh. Their focus on...
reflection.zh: 太平洋岛国领导人正驾驭复杂的地缘政治暗流，但他们向澳大利亚发出的紧急呼吁，凸显了他们眼前的关切：气候变化和毒品交易。这些关乎其人民的福祉和公义，呼应了先知弥迦的呼召，要行公义、好怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行。他们关注切实的需要而非遥远的冲突，提醒我们真正的优先事项往往在哪里。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: US warship arrives in Thailand after record 286 days at sea
title.zh: 美国军舰在海上创纪录航行286天后抵达泰国

summary.en: The USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier arrived in Thailand after a record 286 consecutive days at sea. The extended deployment, which included time in the Middle East and participation in combat operations during the war with Iran, reportedly led to mental health concerns among the approximately 5,000 sailors and...
summary.zh: 美国海军航空母舰“亚伯拉罕·林肯”号在海上连续航行286天，创下纪录后抵达泰国。此次延长的部署任务包括在中东地区停留，并参与了与伊朗的战争中的战斗行动。据报道，船上约5000名海军和海军陆战队员因此出现了心理健康问题。

body.en:
The United States Navy aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln arrived at Thailand's Laem Chabang port on Wednesday after spending 286 consecutive days at sea.

The record-long deployment included an extended period in the Middle East, amid reports of mounting mental health concerns and deteriorating conditions aboard the vessel.

The carrier, which has around 5,000 sailors and marines on board, was deployed in November last year and took part in the US naval blockade and combat operations during the war with Iran.

US Navy deployments typically last between six and nine months, although they can be extended during periods of conflict.

This deployment set a modern-era record for consecutive days at sea, according to US officials.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The Abraham Lincoln, accompanied by other US naval vessels, will spend five days in Thailand for rest and recuperation, according to Thai officials.

"Our arrival in Laem Chabang provides a well-deserved opportunity for our Sailors and Marines to rest and recharge. It also underscores the strong and enduring partnership and alliance between the United States and Thailand," the commander of Carrier Strike Group 3, Rear Admiral Robert E. Loughran, said in a statement.

"What this strike group has accomplished is truly historic. I could not be prouder of the exceptional professionalism and expertise demonstrated by every member of this team during our operations."

Thailand became a US treaty ally in 1954, before being designated a major non-NATO ally in 2003. Thailand's armed forces have long been reliant on US defence hardware and both countries' militaries maintain strong relations and hold annual exercises together.

Thailand has made it clear the visit is for logistics, rest, and recuperation, in line with its treaty commitments, and is not connected to the conflict in the Middle East.

The arrival of thousands of military personnel has raised hopes of an economic boost for the nearby ‌resort city of Pattaya, which also has a longstanding reputation as a sex tourism destination.

A fleet of around 40 buses will ferry the military personnel between Pattaya and the port at Laem Chabang where the vessels will dock, Pattaya Mayor Poramase Ngampiches said. Pattaya sits on the Gulf of Thailand, about 150km southeast of Bangkok.

"There are certain places and activities that the personnel are prohibited from participating in, such as all kinds of water sports, jet skiing, bungee jumping, wrestling, and boxing," he told the Reuters news agency.

Police will deploy additional patrols around Pattaya's main beachfront and nightlife district, following raids over the weekend that led to 40 to...
body.zh: 美国海军航空母舰亚伯拉罕·林肯号在连续海上航行286天后于周三抵达泰国林查班港。 这次创纪录的部署时间包括在中东的较长一段时间，有报道称，船上的心理健康问题日益严重，船上的情况不断恶化。 这艘航母载有约5000名水手和海军陆战队员，于去年11月部署，并在与伊朗的战争期间参加了美国的海上封锁和作战行动。 美国海军的部署通常持续六到九个月，但在冲突期间可能会延长。 美国官员称，这次部署创下了海上连续几天的现代记录。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 据泰国官员称，亚伯拉罕·林肯号将在其他美国海军舰艇的陪同下在泰国休养五天。 “我们抵达林查班为我们的水手和海军陆战队员提供了一个当之无愧的休息和充电的机会。这也凸显了美国和泰国之间强大而持久的伙伴关系和联盟，”第三航母战斗群司令罗伯特·E·洛夫兰少将在一份声明中说。 “这个打击群所取得的成就确实具有历史意义。我对这个团队的每个成员在行动中所表现出的卓越专业精神和专业知识感到无比自豪。” 泰国于 1954 年成为美国的条约盟友，并于 2003 年被指定为主要的非北约盟友。泰国武装部队长期以来一直依赖美国的国防硬件，两国军队保持着牢固的关系，并每年举行联合演习。 泰国已明确表示，此次访问是为了履行其条约承诺，进行后勤、休息和休养，与中东冲突无关。 数千名军事人员的到来给附近的度假城市芭堤雅带来了经济增长的希望，芭堤雅也素有性旅游目的地的美誉。 芭堤雅市长 Poramase Ngampiches 表示，由约 40 辆巴士组成的车队将在芭堤雅和军舰停靠的林查班港之间运送军事人员。芭堤雅位于泰国湾，距曼谷东南约 150 公里。 他对路透社表示：“有些场所和活动是禁止人员参加的，例如各种水上运动、水上摩托艇、蹦极、摔跤和拳击。” 继周末突袭导致 40 人受伤后，警方将在芭堤雅主要海滨和夜生活区周围部署更多巡逻人员。

reflection.en: After an unprecedented 286 days at sea, the USS Abraham Lincoln has reached port. This extended deployment, reportedly taking a toll on the mental well-being of its 5,000 crew members, highlights the profound exhaustion that prolonged service can bring. Yet, the prophet Isaiah offers a timeless promise: 'those who hope in Yahweh will renew their strength.'...
reflection.zh: 在创纪录的286天海上航行后，“亚伯拉罕·林肯”号航母终于抵达港口。这次延长的部署任务据报道给船上5000名船员的心理健康带来了影响，凸显了长期服役可能带来的巨大疲惫。然而，先知以赛亚提供了一个永恒的应许：“那等候雅伟的，必从新得力。”愿我们记念那些服役的人们，愿他们能找到安息和重燃的希望。

verse.textEn: Those who hope in Yahweh will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary.
verse.textZh: 但那等候雅伟的，必从新得力。他们必如鹰展翅上腾。

title.en: 'Miracles do happen': Search and rescue continues as more Australians found alive in Nepal
title.zh: “奇迹确实会发生”：尼泊尔发现更多澳大利亚人生还，搜救仍在继续

summary.en: Four more Australians have been found safe, as hopes fade for survivors as Nepal's flood death toll rises to 1,114. Six Australians have now been located since the floods hit the Nepal-China border last Wednesday, with the number of missing Australians revised down to 38.
summary.zh: 随着尼泊尔洪灾死亡人数升至1114人，幸存者的希望渐灭，又有四名澳大利亚人被找到。自上周三洪水袭击尼泊尔-中国边境以来，已有六名澳大利亚人被找到，失踪的澳大利亚人数已下调至38人。

body.en:
Four more Australians have been confirmed safe in the Nepal-Tibet region following devastating flooding and the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade has revised the number of missing Australians down to 38.

At least 1,114 people have been killed in Nepal after a glacial collapse triggered devastating flash floods, with nearly 4,000 people still unaccounted for.

Six Australians have now been located since the floods hit the Nepal-China border last Wednesday. Officials were in contact with an Australian in Tibet on Tuesday after another Australian, Cara Severino, was found safe in Nepal over the weekend.

According to the ABC, one of the four other Australians located was found in Nepal. The remaining three were found outside of the location where the flooding took place. Their welfare is currently not known.

Australian aid supplies aboard a Royal Australian Air Force plane that departed earlier this week were due to arrive in Nepal on Wednesday morning.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Nepali rescue teams are digging, drilling and blasting through debris in a desperate race against time to free around 100 hydropower workers believed trapped in multiple tunnels.

Authorities said 279 people had been rescued from the ruins of hydropower projects, but at least 639 more were still missing, some of whom are believed to be trapped in tunnels.

Specialised rescue teams from India, China and the United States are involved in the tunnel rescue attempts.

"The plan today is to get on a helicopter and go to the hydro tunnels where they believe there's still life," Ferrin Cole, a member of the US crisis response team currently in Nepal, told ANI news agency.

"We have high-technology listening equipment to listen for sounds of life. And then the safety teams to go in and check."

So far, rescuers have recovered only bodies from tunnels blocked by sludge, and hopes of finding survivors are fading, with officials fearing many are buried under debris left by the floods that tore through towns and valleys near the Chinese border.

"The hope of finding survivors is decreasing," Phanindra Paudel, a senior official at the government's National Emergency Operation Center, said via the Reuters news agency.

Excavators worked into the night on Tuesday, but an army update noted that "a large amount of water started flowing" into a hole they were digging, forcing them to start a new opening.

Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah has called the catastrophe "unimaginable and heartbreaking".

With mortuaries overflowing in Nepal, authorities have begun burying hundreds of unidentified bodies after DNA sampling.

Police, using a drone to search for survivors, said on...

reflection.en: In the midst of devastating floods in Nepal, where the death toll tragically climbs, there is a glimmer of hope. The news that four more Australians have been found safe offers a powerful reminder that even in the darkest hours, joy can emerge from sorrow. This turn of events, where despair begins to recede for some, echoes the ancient promise that weeping...
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔毁灭性的洪水灾难中，死亡人数令人痛惜地攀升，但仍有一线希望。又有四名澳大利亚人被安全找到的消息，有力地提醒我们，即使在最黑暗的时刻，喜乐也可能从悲伤中涌现。这种绝望感开始消退的转变，呼应了古老的应许：哭泣或许会持续一夜，但喜乐必在早晨来到。

verse.textEn: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
verse.textZh: 一宿虽然有哭泣，早晨便必欢呼。

title.en: I've worked with families of missing people for 25 years. Here's how uncertainty feels
title.zh: 我曾与失踪者家属共事25年。我知道不确定性是什么感觉

summary.en: Loved ones of missing people must grapple with the possibility that they may never know for certain what happened. The devastating flash floods in Nepal and Tibet have claimed over 1,000 lives, with at least 42 Australians among more than 4,000 people still unaccounted for. The ambiguity of 'unaccounted for' creates...
summary.zh: 失踪者的亲人必须面对他们可能永远无法确切知道发生了什么的可能。尼泊尔和西藏毁灭性的山洪暴发已造成1000多人死亡，其中至少有42名澳大利亚人在4000多名仍“下落不明”的人之列。“下落不明”这个词的模糊性给家属带来了不确定性和绝望之间的痛苦差距，因为无法保证他们会收到消息。

body.en:
The surging death count from the devastating flash floods that hit Nepal and Tibet on 26 August has passed 1,000.

At least 42 Australians are among more than 4,000 people still “unaccounted for”. But this phrase "unaccounted" — frequently used in media reports — can split the problem too simply: people are either lost or yet to be found.

For many families waiting for news, this gap between uncertainty and despair is ambiguous — and it’s agonising. There is no guarantee news will ever come.

So, how can people missing loved ones make sense of this traumatic experience while the search continues? And what kind of support will they need?

I have been working with families of missing people for more than 25 years. Here’s what I’ve learnt about their experiences of ambiguous loss.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Ambiguous loss describes an ongoing loss without a resolution or closure. It can affect how people feel and behave, and the kind of support they will need.

While waiting for news of their loved ones in Nepal and Tibet, people will be grappling with the shock and trauma of how the disappearance unfolded, and the scale of the disaster. They will also be facing uncertainty and fear about how long they will be on this path.

When living with an ambiguous loss, it is common to oscillate between hopeful thinking and moments of hopelessness.

People may feel frozen to the time they learned the news, replay their last conversations with that person, or repetitively think up new ways to search and find them.

Families in Australia may also feel helpless being so far away, especially as the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade has asked people to reconsider travelling to the affected areas to look for people who are out of contact. They may feel excluded from searching because they can’t travel to the region.

They may also experience physical and emotional agitation, feel sick in the stomach, or be restless from the need to constantly be on alert for information updates.

When observing how people respond to a missing loved one, it can seem to others that families aren't embracing reality. This might look like clinging to ideas that someone is alive, against the odds, or hoping for a miracle in unlikely circumstances.

This isn’t a family’s decision to not confront the reality, but a normal response to incomprehensible and traumatic situations.

Social workers who work in the field of missing persons learn to encourage families to respond however they need— even if that changes minute by minute.

title.en: The shifting ties in Australia's backyard as 'deep pockets' beckon
title.zh: 澳大利亚后院的变动关系：‘深口袋’的诱惑

summary.en: While China stirs tensions over Taiwan in Palau, island leaders are urging Canberra to focus on climate and drug crime.
summary.zh: 在中国试图在帕劳挑起关于台湾的紧张局势之际，岛屿领导人正敦促堪培拉关注气候变化和毒品犯罪。

body.en:
China and Taiwan's diplomatic tug-of-war is casting a shadow over the ongoing Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) as a handful of national leaders declined to attend — however, experts on the ground caution that a geopolitical focus risks ignoring the core priorities of Australia's neighbours.

The annual 18-member gathering in the Taiwanese-allied nation of Palau opened on Monday with climate change, economic security, and the rising influence of the transnational drug trade top of the agenda.

China has said it has "serious concerns" that Taiwan was invited to attend in its own right, while questions have been raised about whether China has influenced five of 18 national leaders from the forum (those of Kiribati, Fiji, Vanuatu, Samoa and Solomon Island) not to attend.

The cornerstone regional political forum began this year with a pointed message from Palau's President Surangel Whipps Jr, who urged nations to adhere to this year's theme of unity and reminded outside partners that they "do not choose our destination".

This year's PIF takes place as Kiribati moves to constitutionally restrict diplomatic recognition to UN member states only — thus excluding Taiwan — while China actively seeks to strip Taiwan of its 'development partner' status in the forum. This comes nearly two months after a Chinese ballistic missile test in the Pacific Ocean .

Taiwan, a self-governing democracy, broke away from mainland China in 1949. China views it as Chinese territory that must be brought under its control by force if necessary.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has made strengthening regional ties a key focus of his administration's foreign policy, signing multiple bilateral agreements with countries like Fiji, Vanuatu, and Tuvalu.

But despite the noise around China, "leaders have made it clear they're here to work" Tess Newton Cain, principal consultant at Asia-Pacific strategic firm Sustineo, told SBS News from Koror.

"The issue of the China-Taiwan tussle is largely a distraction, and one that they try to minimise."

On Wednesday, $600 million in Australian funding was announced to tackle transnational drug smuggling from South America that is increasingly causing harm across the Pacific.

China has made the PIF something of a battleground, maintaining that Taiwan ought to be sidelined during talks, as it is not technically a "dialogue partner" due to a difficult compromise that PIF members have reached over its status for the past three decades.

Palau, one of the few nations that maintains official diplomatic ties with Taiwan, has accused China of running a coercion campaign against it after travel...
body.zh: 由于少数国家领导人拒绝出席，中国和台湾的外交拉锯战给正在进行的太平洋岛屿论坛（PIF）蒙上了阴影。然而，现场专家警告称，地缘政治焦点可能会忽视澳大利亚邻国的核心优先事项。 一年一度的 18 名成员聚会于周一在台湾盟友帕劳开幕，气候变化、经济安全和跨国毒品贸易影响力不断上升成为首要议题。 中国表示，它“严重关切”台湾本身受邀参加，同时也有人质疑中国是否影响论坛 18 个国家领导人中的 5 个（基里巴斯、斐济、瓦努阿图、萨摩亚和所罗门群岛）不参加。 这一基石区域政治论坛于今年拉开帷幕，帕劳总统小苏兰吉尔·惠普斯发出了尖锐的信息，他敦促各国坚持今年的团结主题，并提醒外部伙伴“我们的目的地不是他们选择的”。 今年的PIF召开之际，基里巴斯从宪法上采取行动，限制仅对联合国成员国进行外交承认，从而将台湾排除在外，而中国则积极寻求剥夺台湾在论坛中的“发展伙伴”地位。这是中国在太平洋进行弹道导弹试验近两个月后的事。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 台湾是一个自治民主国家，于 1949 年脱离中国大陆。中国将其视为中国领土，必要时必须使用武力将其置于其控制之下。 安东尼·阿尔巴内塞总理将加强区域关系作为其政府外交政策的重点，与斐济、瓦努阿图和图瓦卢等国签署了多项双边协议。 不过，尽管中国周围一片喧嚣，“领导人已经明确表示，他们来这里是为了工作”，亚太战略公司 Sustineo 的首席顾问泰丝·牛顿·凯恩 (Tess Newton Cain) 在科罗尔告诉 SBS 新闻。 “中国与台湾的争斗问题在很大程度上是一种干扰，他们试图将其最小化。” 周三，澳大利亚宣布提供 6 亿美元资金，用于打击来自南美洲的跨国毒品走私，这种走私在太平洋沿岸造成的危害日益严重。 中国已将太平洋岛礁论坛变成了一个战场，坚持认为台湾应该在谈判中靠边站，因为过去三十年来，太平洋岛礁论坛成员就其地位达成了艰难的妥协，因此从技术上讲，台湾并不是“对话伙伴”。 帕劳是少数几个与台湾保持正式外交关系的国家之一，该国指责中国在旅行后对其进行胁迫行动......

Prosecutors have accused Wong, 29, of working with the exiled Hong Kong activist Nathan Law to urge foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades or other hostile measures against China. title.en: Nepal-Tibet flood deaths pass 1,000 as police ask relatives for DNA to identify victims
title.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏洪水死亡人数超过1000人，警方要求亲属提供DNA以识别遇难者

summary.en: Relatives of missing tourists were asked for blood samples and photos as rescue efforts continued for hundreds of hydropower workers trapped in the Himalayas. The death toll from devastating floods has surpassed 1,000 nearly a week after the disaster struck towns and valleys across Nepal and Tibet.
