This situation calls to mind the ancient wisdom of speaking for those who cannot speak for themselves, ensuring that rules are applied with compassion and consideration for the well-being of the young. True order is built not on rigid enforcement alone, but...
reflection.zh: 学生们冒雨排队接受检查的场景，让人联想到脆弱和不适。这种情况让人想起古老的智慧——为那些不能为自己说话的人说话，确保规则的执行既有同情心，又能顾及年轻人的福祉。真正的秩序不仅建立在严格的执行之上，更建立在对所有人的关怀和公正之上。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: China’s Xi Jinping holds talks with Sisi in first Egypt visit in a decade
title.zh: 中国国家主席习近平与塞西举行会谈，这是十年来埃及首次迎来习主席到访

summary.en: Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi hosted Chinese President Xi Jinping in Cairo, marking Xi's first visit in a decade. The leaders engaged in talks, underscored by a 21-gun salute at Ittihadiya Palace, focusing on the Middle East conflict's impact, maritime trade security, and increasing Chinese investment in...
summary.zh: 埃及总统阿卜杜勒-法塔赫·塞西周三在开罗接待了到访的中国国家主席习近平，这是习近平十年来首次访问埃及。两国元首在伊蒂哈迪亚宫举行了会谈，仪式以21响礼炮开始。会谈议题包括中东冲突及其影响、海上贸易安全，以及增加中国在埃及的投资。两国均为金砖国家成员。

body.en: Egypt’s President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi on Wednesday received his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping on his first visit to Cairo in a decade, as Beijing seeks a greater foothold in the region against the backdrop of the US-Iran war. China’s Xi Jinping arrived in Egypt to meet President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi on Wednesday, September 2, 2026. Photo: Egypt Gov’t. The 21-gun salute at Cairo’s Ittihadiya Palace marked the start of a day of talks expected to cover the Middle East war and its fallout, including on maritime trade security, as well as boosting Chinese investment in the Arab world’s most populous country. The two BRICS members are expected to sign a slate of economic agreements, including on artificial intelligence, transport and manufacturing. Egypt currently estimates Chinese investments at around US$10 billion. Beijing has key stakes in the Suez Canal Economic Zone, which are only expected to grow as the US-Iran war threatens global maritime trade. Beijing has also played a key role in Sisi’s megaprojects, the crowning jewel of which is the New Administrative Capital 50 kilometres (30 miles) east of Cairo, large swathes of which have been bankrolled by Chinese investment. China is a major exporter to Egypt, with its trade surplus reaching US$12 billion in the first seven months of 2026, according to Chinese customs data. Across Cairo, a megalopolis home to over 26 million people, major streets have been lined with Chinese and Egyptian flags, as well as billboards showing Sisi and Xi. Street signs boast of “generations of Egyptian-Chinese friendship flowing like the Nile River”, while residents have been warned to plan for substantial traffic delays on their commutes. Xi is expected to traverse the entire capital during his visit Wednesday, including a stop at the Grand Egyptian Museum overlooking the Giza Pyramids. ‘Independent foreign policy’ According to analysts, Cairo will use the summit to underscore its strategic autonomy, showing it can leverage its close ties with both Washington and Beijing. President Abdel Fattah Al-Sisi of Egypt in 2020. File photo: Graham Carlow, via UK Gov’t. Sisi, in an op-ed published in Egyptian media on Tuesday, highlighted Cairo’s “independent foreign policy”, days after a branch of Egypt’s second-largest bank was targeted by US sanctions. He wrote that Egypt and China were partners in “strengthening the role of the global south” in an increasingly polarised world. Washington vowed last month to isolate Iran economically, threatening expanded sanctions that could also hit Chinese banks, among others. China, a major buyer of Iranian oil, has vowed to safeguard its interests. Chinese leader Xi Jinping. Photo:...

reflection.en: As leaders from Egypt and China convene for high-level talks, the world watches for signs of diplomatic engagement. The pursuit of peace and stability, even amidst complex geopolitical currents, is a vital endeavor. May these discussions foster understanding and lay groundwork for a more secure and prosperous future for the region and beyond.
reflection.zh: 埃及和中国领导人举行高级别会谈，世界正关注外交互动的迹象。即使在复杂的地缘政治背景下，追求和平与稳定也是一项至关重要的事业。愿此次会谈能增进理解，为该地区及更广泛范围的未来安全与繁荣奠定基础。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Lawmaker urges Hong Kong gov’t to introduce comprehensive population policy amid record-low births
title.zh: 议员敦促香港政府推出全面人口政策，应对生育率创纪录新低

summary.en: A pro-Beijing lawmaker in Hong Kong has called on the government to implement a comprehensive population policy and to investigate young people's views on childbearing, citing record-low birth rates over the past year. Nixie Lam, a legislator, suggested forming a dedicated task force to research the issue.
summary.zh: 一位亲北京的香港议员呼吁政府实施一项全面的人口政策，并研究年轻人对生育的看法，因为过去一年记录到的出生率创下新低。议员林素蔚建议成立一个专门的工作小组进行研究。

body.en: A pro-Beijing Hong Kong lawmaker has urged the government to introduce a comprehensive population policy and to study young people’s thoughts on childbearing amid record-low births logged over the past year. Nixie Lam, a legislator with the Democratic Alliance for the Betterment and Progress of Hong Kong (DAB), told RTHK Radio 1 on Wednesday that although the government has introduced measures to boost fertility, it has so far presented “no comprehensive population policy.” DAB Legislative Council election candidate Nixie Lam. Photo: Candice Chau/HKFP. Lam urged authorities to set up a population policy task force, led by secretarial-grade officers, to conduct research into what young people think about starting families and raising children. “Different policies [linked to fertility] are scattered around different bureaux and government departments,” Lam said in Cantonese, “but without a comprehensive policy people will wonder if the government is actually doing anything to help.“ “In particular, with regard to whether young people want to have children and what impacts [that decision], what pressures they are facing… the government has not conducted any research in recent years,” Lam said. “Without research, we are still using ideas from the last century to formulate relevant policies.” Fewer than 30,000 babies were born in Hong Kong over the past year – a record low for the territory. The number of new births in 2025 came in at around half that of 2015, according to figures from the Census and Statistics Department. Children in Hong Kong. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. These figures come in spite of new measures introduced to boost the local fertility rate, including a new tax allowance for residents receiving assisted reproductive services. In late 2023, a one-off cash allowance of HK$20,000 was offered as a financial incentive to eligible parents. It is unclear whether the “Newborn Baby Bonus” scheme, which was implemented for a period of three years, will be extended when it expires in October. Speaking to the public broadcaster, Lam called on the government to continue providing these payments. Children look at the skyline of Hong Kong. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. She said authorities should not simply cancel the bonus scheme without introducing a comprehensive population policy. Shrinking primary school classes Enrolment at Hong Kong’s kindergartens and primary schools has been dipping amid the record-low birth rate and emigration from the city. Ming Pao reported on Wednesday that, in the new school year, 127 of 446 government-subsidised primary schools in Hong Kong had cut back on Primary One classes. Of these, 60 offered only one Primary One class in the new academic...

reflection.en: The news from Hong Kong highlights a growing concern over declining birth rates, prompting calls for government intervention. This situation invites reflection on the profound gift of children, as Psalm 127:3 reminds us, "Children are a heritage from Yahweh, the fruit of the womb a reward." May leaders and citizens alike consider the value and blessing of...
reflection.zh: 香港传来的消息凸显了人们对出生率下降日益增长的担忧，并呼吁政府介入。这种情况引人反思子女的宝贵恩赐，正如诗篇127:3所提醒我们的：“儿女是雅伟所赐的产业；所怀的胎是他所给的赏赐。”愿领导者和民众都能珍视新生命的价值与祝福。

verse.textEn: Children are a heritage from Yahweh, offspring a reward from him.
verse.textZh: 儿女是雅伟所赐的产业。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty in second national security case
title.zh: 香港民主派活动人士黄之锋承认在第二起国安案中认罪

summary.en: Joshua Wong, a prominent pro-democracy activist in Hong Kong, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to charges under the national security law, specifically conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against China. The charge carries a maximum penalty of life imprisonment.
summary.zh: 香港一位著名的民主派活动人士黄之锋周三承认触犯国安法，罪名是共谋寻求外国制裁中国，该罪名最高可判处无期徒刑。

body.en: Wong, 29, is accused of urging foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades and other hostile measures against China Joshua Wong , one of Hong Kong’s most prominent pro-democracy activists, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against Hong Kong and China, a national security charge that carries a maximum life sentence. Prosecutors have accused Wong, 29, of working with the exiled Hong Kong activist Nathan Law to urge foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades or other hostile measures against China. Continue reading...
body.zh: 29 岁的黄之锋被指控敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁和其他敌对措施。香港最著名的民主活动人士之一黄之锋周三承认密谋寻求外国对香港和中国实施制裁，这一国家安全指控最高可判处无期徒刑。检察官指控 29 岁的黄与流亡香港活动人士罗冠聪合作，敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁或其他敌对措施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Joshua Wong, a young activist known for his role in Hong Kong's democracy movement, has pleaded guilty to charges under the national security law. This situation brings to the fore the difficult tension between civic obedience and deeply held convictions. The apostles' unwavering stance, 'We must obey God rather than human beings,' offers a timeless...
reflection.zh: 香港一位以其在民主运动中角色而闻名的年轻活动人士黄之锋，已承认触犯国安法。这一局面凸显了公民服从与内心深处信念之间的艰难张力。使徒们坚定的立场——“顺从神，过于顺从人”——为这种良心冲突提供了永恒的视角。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Shein shares slide on fast-fashion retailer’s stock market debut
title.zh: Shein股票上市首日下跌，快时尚零售商估值缩水

summary.en: Shares of the fast-fashion brand Shein fell as much as 10% on their debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The company, founded in China and now headquartered in Singapore, was valued at just over $26 billion, a significant drop from its previous valuation of nearly $100 billion.
summary.zh: 快时尚品牌Shein在香港证券交易所上市首日股价下跌高达10%。这家中国创立、现总部设在新加坡的公司，估值略高于260亿美元，远低于其此前近1000亿美元的估值。

body.en: Hong Kong flotation at $26bn by firm once valued at $100bn follows failure to list in US and UK Shares in the fast-fashion brand Shein slumped by as much as 10% as the China-founded company made its long-anticipated trading debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The Singapore-headquartered company, once valued at almost $100bn (£74bn), went public on Tuesday pricing shares at HK$48.56, valuing the business at just over $26bn. Continue reading...
body.zh: 曾估值 1000 亿美元的公司在香港发行 260 亿美元，此前该公司未能在美国和英国上市。快时尚品牌 Shein 在香港证券交易所首次上市后，其股价下跌了 10%。这家总部位于新加坡的公司一度估值近 1000 亿美元（740 亿英镑），周二上市，股价为 48.56 港元，业务估值略高于 260 亿美元。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The dramatic drop in Shein's valuation on its Hong Kong stock market debut, from nearly $100 billion to just over $26 billion, serves as a potent reminder of the volatile nature of commerce. Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to commit our endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish our plans, a wisdom that transcends market highs and lows.
reflection.zh: Shein在香港股市上市首日估值从近1000亿美元暴跌至略高于260亿美元，这有力地提醒我们商业的波动性。箴言16:3鼓励我们将所做的事交托给雅伟，信靠祂必成就我们的计划，这智慧超越了市场的起伏。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Science & Nature Desk
title.zh: 自然科学

strap.en: Discoveries in nature, climate, health, and the wider cosmos.
strap.zh: 自然、气候、健康与宇宙万象的新发现。

title.en: Health record analysis of one million cattle identifies early prevention as key to reducing feedlot respiratory deaths
title.zh: 对一百万头牛的健康记录分析确定早期预防是减少牛舍呼吸道死亡的关键

summary.en: New research involving over 1 million Australian feedlot cattle has revealed that the primary indicators of death from bovine respiratory disease (BRD) are present before the animals are placed in feedlots. This underscores the critical need for preventative health measures at the source properties where the cattle...
summary.zh: 一项涉及超过一百万头澳大利亚饲养场牛的新研究发现，导致牛呼吸道疾病（BRD）死亡的最强预测因素在牛进入饲养场之前就已经存在。这凸显了在牛的来源地采取预防措施的重要性。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

New research involving more than 1 million Australian feedlot cattle has found that the strongest predictors of death from bovine respiratory disease (BRD) are established before animals even enter the feedlot, highlighting the importance of preventive measures on source properties.

The study, led by Adelaide University in partnership with Apiam Animal Health and Meat and Livestock Australia, analyzed health and production records from 1,040,253 cattle across three Australian feedlots between 2018 and 2024, making it the largest Australian investigation of BRD-specific mortality conducted to date. It has been published in Preventive Veterinary Medicine.

While the overall mortality rate in Australian feedlots is very low (less than 0.5%), bovine respiratory disease is a leading infectious cause of illness and death in feedlot cattle and accounted for nearly 38% of all feedlot deaths recorded in the study.

The team discovered that cattle from supplier properties with a history of elevated BRD mortality were more than four times as likely to die from the disease as cattle from lower-risk properties. This may provide a potential basis for using supplier history to identify higher-risk consignments before they arrive.

Researchers also found that where cattle were sourced mattered. Cattle purchased through auction yards had a significantly higher risk of BRD mortality than cattle sourced directly from paddocks, an association consistent with the additional handling, transport and commingling involved in auction-yard procurement.

Importantly, the study showed that most BRD deaths occurred early in the feeding period. About 69% of deaths happened within the first 60 days on feed, with the highest mortality risk occurring around day 35 after arrival.

Darren Trott, director of Adelaide University's Australian Center for Antimicrobial Resistance Ecology and a senior author on the study, said the findings reinforce the importance of identifying and managing BRD risk before cattle arrive at a feedlot.

"Our results show that the biggest drivers of respiratory disease mortality are already in place before cattle enter the feedlot," Trott said. "Factors linked to the source property, the way cattle are managed before transport and how they are vaccinated can have a profound impact on survival.

"However, a supplier's risk profile should not be viewed as permanent. It needs to be continually updated as new performance data become available so that changes in risk can be recognized and management decisions adjusted accordingly," Trott said.

The research provides strong support for...

reflection.en: This extensive study of over a million cattle emphasizes that proactive care, established early in an animal's life, is the most effective way to prevent disease and death. It's a reminder that diligent planning and commitment to our work, whether in agriculture or any other field, can lead to better outcomes and honor Yahweh.
reflection.zh: 这项对一百万多头牛进行的广泛研究强调，在动物生命早期建立的积极护理是预防疾病和死亡最有效的方式。它提醒我们，勤奋的计划和对工作的投入，无论是在农业还是其他领域，都能带来更好的结果，并荣耀雅伟。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: New 'devil flower' species discovered in Thai national park
title.zh: 泰国国家公园发现新“魔鬼花”物种

summary.en: Researchers have identified and described a new species of leafless flowering plant found on the forest floor of a national park in western Thailand. Its unusual appearance has led to its naming as Thismia daemona, or the 'devil flower.' This plant, like others in its genus, lacks chlorophyll and derives nutrients...
summary.zh: 研究人员在泰国西部一个国家公园的森林地面上发现了一种新的无叶开花植物，并对其进行了描述。它奇特的外观使其被命名为Thismia daemona，意为“魔鬼花”。该植物与同属的其他物种一样，不含叶绿素，通过地下的真菌获取营养，大部分生命周期都隐藏在地下。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Researchers have described a new species of leafless flowering plant found on the forest floor of a national park in western Thailand, and its otherworldly appearance has earned it a fittingly dramatic name: Thismia daemona, the "devil flower."

The species belongs to Thismia, a genus of small plants sometimes called "fairy lanterns." Unlike most plants, they contain no chlorophyll and cannot photosynthesize, instead drawing nutrients from underground fungi and spending almost their entire lives hidden beneath leaf litter.

The new species was found by botanists from Chulalongkorn University and Prince of Songkla University during surveys of Thong Pha Phum National Park. It was growing at an elevation of nearly 1,000 meters (3,300 feet), an unusually high and seasonally dry setting for the genus.

The study, published in the open-access journal PhytoKeys , brings the number of Thismia species recorded in Thailand to 16.

"Finding Thismia daemona in Thong Pha Phum National Park was indeed a major surprise," said Dr. Sahut Chantanaorrapint of Prince of Songkla University. "Typically, Thismia species are known to occur in perennially humid lowland rainforests; however, this population was discovered in a seasonal, montane evergreen forest at an elevation of nearly 1,000 meters (3,300 feet) above sea level."

The find matters well beyond Thailand's borders. The new species belongs to Thismia section Geomitra, previously known only from Peninsular Malaysia, Borneo and Sumatra, so its discovery pushes the known range of the whole section northward for the first time.

Its looks live up to the name. The flower is mostly black, with horn-like appendages crowning a dome-shaped "miter," while patches of vivid reddish-orange around its base recall a demon's glowing eyes. "Combined with its hidden, subterranean and mysterious lifestyle on the forest floor, our team unanimously agreed that naming it Thismia daemona perfectly captured its enigmatic and devil-like essence," Chantanaorrapint said.

Despite its interesting appearance, its future is precarious. Known from a single population of fewer than 50 individuals in an area smaller than a football field, it has provisionally been assessed as Critically Endangered, partly because its habitat sits within a national park popular with tourists.

Chantanaorrapint sees community involvement as key to its survival: "A key next step is adopting a sustainable conservation approach aligned with the UNESCO Man and the Biosphere concept, harmonizing biodiversity conservation with human engagement. Inspiring local people to take pride in their...

reflection.en: The discovery of Thismia daemona, the 'devil flower,' in a Thai national park is a testament to the boundless creativity and intricate design within God's creation. Even in hidden corners of the earth, Yahweh's wisdom and provision are evident in the unique forms and life cycles of His creatures. This new species reminds us that the natural world is full of...
reflection.zh: 在泰国国家公园发现的“魔鬼花”（Thismia daemona）新物种，证明了雅伟创造中无限的创意和精妙的设计。即使在地球隐蔽的角落，雅伟的智慧和供应也体现在祂造物的独特形态和生命周期中。 这个新物种提醒我们，大自然充满了等待被发掘的奇迹，每一个都反映了造物主的艺术和丰盛。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Tracking emperor penguins from space
title.zh: 从太空追踪帝企鹅

summary.en: For the first time, geographers from Durham University have utilized freely available satellite radar images to track emperor penguins throughout the polar winter, providing a year-round view of their movements. Monitoring these endangered birds during Antarctica's dark months is crucial as it represents a key stage...
summary.zh: 来自杜伦大学的地理学家首次利用免费的卫星雷达图像，在整个极地冬季追踪帝企鹅的行踪，从而提供了它们全年的活动情况。监测这些濒危鸟类度过南极的黑暗月份至关重要，因为这是它们繁殖周期的关键阶段。帝企鹅依靠附着在海岸线上的稳定海冰，大约九个月的时间来繁殖和抚养幼雏。

body.en: For the first time, geographers from Durham University have used freely available satellite radar images to track emperor penguins through the polar winter—giving a year-round view of their movements. Monitoring the endangered birds through Antarctica's dark months is important because this is a key stage in their breeding cycle. Emperor penguins rely on stable sea ice attached to the coastline for roughly nine months to breed and raise chicks.

reflection.en: The vastness of Antarctica and the resilience of emperor penguins navigating its harsh winter are awe-inspiring. This scientific endeavor, using satellite technology to understand their breeding cycle, reveals the intricate wonders of Yahweh's creation. It reminds us that even in the most remote and challenging environments, life finds a way, a testament to...
reflection.zh: 南极洲的广袤和帝企鹅在严酷冬季中顽强生存的能力令人惊叹。这项利用卫星技术了解其繁殖周期的科学努力，揭示了雅伟创造的复杂奇迹。它提醒我们，即使在最偏远和最具挑战性的环境中，生命也能找到出路，这证明了创造主的深邃智慧和设计。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: German cities reveal warmer nights in districts with more non-German residents
title.zh: 德国城市显示，非德籍居民较多的地区夜晚更温暖

summary.en: As climate change intensifies, urban heat adaptation becomes increasingly critical. Researchers at the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT) have investigated the relationship between sociodemographic factors—including nationality, age, and rent—and heat exposure across Germany. Their findings indicate that in 84.2%...
summary.zh: 随着气候变化加剧，城市热适应变得越来越重要。卡尔斯鲁厄理工学院（KIT）的研究人员调查了社会人口统计因素（包括国籍、年龄和租金）与德国各地热暴露之间的关系。他们的研究结果表明，在所分析城市的84.2%中，非德籍居民比例较高的地区夜间气温明显更高，揭示了城市内部明显的气温空间差异。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Urban heat adaptation will gain in importance as climate change progresses. Researchers at the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT) have analyzed how sociodemographic factors (nationality, age, and rent) correlate with heat exposure throughout Germany.

The clearest correlation involves nationality: In 84.2% of the analyzed cities, the air was significantly warmer at night in areas with a higher share of residents without German citizenship. The data show clear spatial differences in intra-city temperature but allow no conclusions about their causes.

According to the EU's Earth observation program Copernicus, June and July 2026 were warmer than any other two-month period on record. Climate change is exacerbating such extreme heat events, and the consequences are especially evident in cities, whose sealed surfaces and buildings store heat during the day and radiate it away at night.

In addition, cities have less vegetation to provide shade and cool the surroundings through evaporation. This urban heat island effect has been known for decades and is well researched.

In contrast, there has been little analysis of the social distribution of heat stress. "Thus far we've known relatively little about which demographics are exposed to especially high temperatures in cities," said Dr. Susanne Benz from KIT's Institute of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing (IPF).

"Our work also considers these differences from an environmental justice perspective , in other words, whether different demographics have different exposure to environmental stressors." This also involves the question of whether certain demographics are found more frequently in districts with high building density and fewer green spaces that lead to higher temperatures.

In their project, the researchers analyzed all districts (Landkreise) and independent cities (kreisfreie Städte) in Germany, combining air and land surface temperatures (day and night) in the summer months from 2021 to 2023 to derive an aggregate temperature parameter.

To account for urbanization's specific impact on temperature, they determined the urban heat island intensity by comparing urban temperatures with those of neighboring rural areas with similar topography.

They then correlated the temperature data with the results of the 2022 census, taking three sociodemographic factors into consideration: the share of the population without German citizenship, the share of people over 65 years old, and rent per person as a possible indicator of socioeconomic status. For each factor, they compared temperatures within each district for areas with...

reflection.en: This study reveals a correlation between the concentration of non-German residents and warmer nighttime temperatures in German cities. It prompts reflection on how societal structures and environmental conditions can disproportionately affect different populations. The biblical call to treat the foreigner as one's own kin (Leviticus 19:33) challenges us to...
reflection.zh: 这项研究揭示了德国城市中非德籍居民的聚集与夜间气温升高之间的相关性。这促使我们反思社会结构和环境条件如何可能不成比例地影响不同人群。圣经中呼吁要待客如本地人（利未记19:33），这挑战我们思考，无论背景如何，所有居民是否都享有公平的生活条件和关怀。

verse.textEn: When a foreigner resides among you in your land, do not mistreat them. The foreigner residing among you must be treated as your native-born. Love them as yourself, for you were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 若有外人在你们国中和你同居，就不可欺负他。和你们同居的外人，你们要看他如本地人一样，并要爱他如己，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: US medical groups urge people to get flu and Covid shots in counter to Trump guidance
title.zh: 美国医学团体呼吁接种流感和新冠疫苗，以对抗特朗普的指导方针

summary.en: Leading US medical groups are urging people to get updated flu and Covid-19 vaccinations this fall, banding together to issue shot guidelines and highlight the science behind them, aiming to ease confusion caused by the Trump administration’s changing immunization advice.
summary.zh: 美国顶尖医学团体正在敦促人们在今年秋季接种更新的流感和新冠疫苗，他们联合发布了疫苗接种指南，并强调其背后的科学依据，旨在缓解特朗普政府不断变化的免疫接种建议所造成的困惑。

body.en: Top medical groups band together to ease confusion from Trump administration’s changing immunization advice Leading US medical groups are urging people to get updated flu and Covid-19 vaccinations this fall, banding together on Wednesday to issue shot guidelines – and highlight the science behind them – saying they hope to ease confusion caused by the Trump administration’s changing advice. Flu vaccinations are beginning and the latest coronavirus shots are starting to arrive after the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved this year’s updated versions last week. Winter also brings another vaccine-preventable risk called RSV. Continue reading...

reflection.en: In times of shifting public health guidance, clear, science-based advice is crucial. The collaboration of medical groups to offer unified recommendations demonstrates the value of seeking and heeding expert counsel, especially when navigating complex health decisions. This collective effort aims to bring clarity and confidence to the public.
reflection.zh: 在公共卫生指导方针不断变化的时期，清晰、基于科学的建议至关重要。医学团体联合起来提供统一的建议，这体现了在应对复杂的健康决策时，寻求和听取专家意见的价值。这种集体努力旨在为公众带来清晰和信心。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Interstellar solar sails hit a strange problem at 75% of light speed
title.zh: 星际太阳帆在光速的75%时遇到奇怪的问题

summary.en: Solar sails propelled by powerful lasers could achieve incredible speeds, but relativity might eventually cause the light itself to impede them. At approximately 75% of the speed of light, scattered photons can create drag, presenting a surprising obstacle to interstellar travel.
summary.zh: 由强大激光驱动的太阳帆可以达到惊人的速度，但相对论最终可能会使光本身成为阻碍。在光速的75%左右，散射的光子会产生阻力，为星际旅行带来了令人惊讶的障碍。

body.en:
Reaching another star within a practical amount of time will require something far more capable than chemical rockets. One of the leading ideas is a solar sail, a large reflective structure that can be pushed by light. If extremely powerful lasers are aimed at such a sail, they could accelerate it to speeds well beyond what current propulsion systems can achieve.

But there may be an unexpected problem once a lightsail begins traveling at a significant fraction of the speed of light. According to a new paper on arXiv by Chao Shen and Jiaze Li of the Harbin Institute of Technology, the same light used to propel the sail could eventually produce a drag effect.

The researchers separate the forces produced by photons striking a solar sail into three categories.

The strongest contribution comes from incident light (that raw momentum of the photons hitting the sail). Next is specular reflection (momentum imparted when photons bounce perfectly off the sail). The weakest contribution comes from diffuse scattering (momentum from photons that are absorbed by the sail then reemitted in random directions).

At relatively low speeds, these effects all contribute to pushing the sail forward. The situation becomes much more complicated once the spacecraft reaches relativistic velocities.

As the sail races away from the laser source, the light reaching it undergoes an increasingly strong Doppler shift. The frequency of the incoming light decreases, reducing the amount of thrust produced by all three components.

As a result, continued acceleration becomes progressively less efficient. The faster the sail travels, the harder it becomes for the laser to keep increasing its speed.

The situation changes even more dramatically once the lightsail reaches about 75% of the speed of light.

At that speed, relativistic light aberration becomes important. From the viewpoint of a stationary observer on Earth, diffusely scattered light begins to be directed forward, toward the direction in which the sail is traveling.

Because every action has an equal and opposite reaction, that forward-directed radiation produces a force in the opposite direction. This means diffuse scattering (admittedly the weakest of the three forces) begins acting as drag once the sail passes roughly 75% of the speed of light.

The laser is still pushing the sail forward overall, so the total force does not become negative. However, the efficiency of the propulsion system drops substantially.

The study is focused specifically on radiative dynamics. It does not include nonradiative effects such as collisions and drag from interstellar gas or dust.

It also leaves out the thermal limits of real sail materials. A sail exposed to an extremely powerful laser could potentially overheat or even melt.

For...

reflection.en: Humanity's quest to explore the stars, as described in this report on solar sails, is a testament to our God-given curiosity and ingenuity. Yet, as we push the boundaries of physics, we encounter the universe's intricate laws, reminding us that even our most advanced knowledge is still unfolding. The prophet Daniel foresaw a time when 'knowledge shall...
reflection.zh: 人类探索星辰的追求，正如这篇关于太阳帆的报道所述，证明了我们上帝所赐的好奇心和创造力。然而，当我们突破物理学的界限时，我们会遇到宇宙错综复杂的定律，这提醒我们，即使是我们最先进的知识仍在不断发展。先知但以理预见到一个“知识必增长”的时代——这恰如其分地描述了我们持续的科学探索。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Money problems may age your brain faster
title.zh: 金钱问题可能加速您的大脑衰老

summary.en: New research indicates that enduring financial difficulties in early and middle adulthood are associated with diminished cognitive abilities and increased signs of brain aging by later life. The study suggests that chronic stress and worry stemming from financial hardship may progressively harm the brain.
summary.zh: 一项新研究表明，成年早期和中期持续的经济困难与晚年认知能力下降和大脑衰老迹象增加有关。研究表明，经济困难带来的慢性压力和担忧可能逐渐损害大脑。

body.en:
Persistent financial hardship may speed up age-related cognitive decline, according to new research led by University College London (UCL).

Published in Innovation in Aging , the study analyzed information from 2,759 people in the UK who completed questionnaires across much of their lives through the MRC National Survey of Health and Development (also known as the 1946 British cohort study).

Researchers found that people who faced ongoing financial difficulties or persistently low income during early and middle adulthood tended to perform worse on cognitive tests by the age of 53.

Among a subgroup who later underwent brain scans, persistent low income was also associated with poorer brain health (including more brain shrinkage) in later life (ages 69 to 71).

These associations remained after the researchers accounted for other factors that could have influenced the results, including childhood cognitive ability, education level and childhood disadvantage.

Corresponding author Dr. Jacques Wels (Unit for Lifelong Health & Ageing at UCL) said: "Most studies on cognitive aging look at financial hardship at only a single point in time. Our study using several decades of data allows us to see that it is the accumulation of hardship over many years that is linked to the worst cognitive health outcomes, rather than occasional episodes of adversity."

Senior author Professor Praveetha Patalay (Unit for Lifelong Health & Ageing and Centre for Longitudinal Studies, UCL) said: "Our findings suggest that supporting people facing financial hardship and reducing chronic poverty could also help prevent cognitive decline and dementia cases in the future."

The relationship between financial adversity and poorer brain health later in life appeared especially strong among men, people who had experienced childhood disadvantage, and those who carried APOE-ε4, a genetic variant associated with an increased risk of Alzheimer's disease.

Men who experienced persistent financial adversity also performed worse on cognitive tests at age 53 than their female counterparts.

The researchers suggested several possible explanations for this difference. Disadvantaged men may have been more likely than disadvantaged women to engage in unhealthy behaviors (such as smoking and alcohol misuse). Men in this generation may also have experienced financial strain differently because they were more likely to have been the primary breadwinners in this cohort born in 1946.

Several biological and psychological pathways could help explain the connection between financial hardship and cognitive aging.

One possibility is inflammation. Chronic stress can promote inflammation, which is known to contribute to faster brain aging.

Persistent concern about finances could also increase...

reflection.en: This study highlights how persistent financial struggles can take a tangible toll on our cognitive health, accelerating brain aging. It serves as a somber reminder of the profound impact of our circumstances on our well-being, urging us to seek wisdom in how we navigate life's challenges and value our time.
reflection.zh: 这项研究强调，持续的经济困境会对我们的认知健康造成切实的损害，加速大脑衰老。它警示我们，生活环境对身心健康的深远影响，并促使我们在应对生活挑战和珍惜时光时寻求智慧。

verse.textEn: Teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
verse.textZh: 求你指教我们怎样数算自己的日子，好叫我们得着智慧的心。

title.en: Alzheimer’s may leave a mark on the brain long before plaques appear
title.zh: 阿尔茨海默病可能在斑块出现前很久就在大脑留下印记

summary.en: New research suggests that brain changes linked to Alzheimer's disease may begin at least seven years before amyloid plaques are detectable by current PET scans. Scientists tracked healthy older adults using repeated brain imaging over nearly two decades, identifying structural changes years before plaques became...
summary.zh: 一项新研究表明，与阿尔茨海默病相关的脑部变化可能在现有PET扫描可检测到淀粉样蛋白斑块之前的至少七年就开始出现。研究人员通过对健康老年人近二十年的重复脑部成像追踪，在斑块变得可见前数年就识别出了结构性变化。

body.en:
A new study suggests that brain imaging could reveal changes linked to Alzheimer's disease more than seven years earlier than researchers previously believed. The work was led by scientists in the Department of Psychology at the University of Oslo and was published in Nature Neuroscience.

The study suggests that the current gold standard for Alzheimer's imaging (amyloid-PET) may not be sensitive enough to capture some of the earliest brain changes associated with the disease. These include processes related to the buildup of amyloid plaques. The researchers identified structural changes in the brain at least seven years before plaques became visible on scans.

"We found that structural changes in the brain occur many years before high levels of plaque are seen on PET scans, which is the brain scan currently used to identify the earliest signs of Alzheimer's disease," says James Michael Roe.

At the time the research was carried out, Roe was a postdoctoral researcher at the Center for Lifespan Changes in Brain and Cognition (LCBC) at the Department of Psychology, University of Oslo. He now works as International Scientific Lead at Cercare Medical. Roe was the study's main researcher while working at LCBC.

According to Roe, the results suggest that disease-related processes may already be developing in the brain long before they can be seen with today's most sensitive imaging methods.

"We found the earliest signal detected on brain scans to date, which could be useful for tracking the disease before symptoms emerge and may help with earlier detection," he says.

To uncover these early changes, the researchers followed healthy individuals who underwent regular brain scans (MRI) for nearly 20 years. The long span of imaging data allowed the team to determine when plaques first became detectable and which participants eventually developed them.

The researchers then looked back at MRI scans collected during the previous decade. They compared changes in brain structure among people who later showed plaques with changes seen in people who did not.

"The most groundbreaking aspect of this study is that we found structural changes in the brain many years before the first signs of plaque buildup, which is considered to be the earliest sign of Alzheimer's disease," says Anders Martin Fjell, Professor at the Department of Psychology, and head of LCBC.

"These are cognitively well-functioning older individuals. What is unique here is that we have examined changes in brain structure in the years before the first scan revealed plaques," says Fjell.

Fjell notes that Alzheimer's disease remains extremely difficult to treat. One reason is that it is closely connected with aging and is probably influenced by several different biological factors.

"These findings...

reflection.en: The intricate workings of the human brain, even in its earliest stages of decline, are a testament to the complex design of creation. This research, by observing and understanding these subtle changes, reflects a deep engagement with the mysteries Yahweh has woven into our physical being. It reminds us that even in the face of disease, the pursuit of...
reflection.zh: 人类大脑的复杂运作，即使在其衰退的早期阶段，也证明了造物主设计的精妙。这项研究通过观察和理解这些细微的变化，体现了对雅伟编织在我们物质存在中的奥秘的深刻探索。它提醒我们，即使面对疾病，对我们身体的知识追求也可以是对造物主工巧的尊崇。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: A coffee-table-size scorpion roamed Earth before forests existed
title.zh: 一种咖啡桌大小的蝎子在森林存在之前就已漫游地球

summary.en: A meter-long scorpion with massive pincers stalked ancient Britain 415 million years ago, long before forests and the better-known age of giant insects. Its surprising size and possible semi-aquatic lifestyle could reshape ideas about how early arthropods became giants.
summary.zh: 一种拥有巨大螯的、长达一米的蝎子在 4.15 亿年前的古代英国游荡，远在森林和更广为人知的巨型昆虫时代之前。它令人惊讶的体型和可能的半水生生活方式可能会重塑人们对早期节肢动物如何长成巨型的看法。

body.en:
A newly analyzed fossil predator from what is now England and Wales has been identified as the largest scorpion known to science. Researchers from The University of Manchester and the Natural History Museum reached the conclusion after revisiting fossils that had remained in museum collections for more than 150 years.

The animal, Praearcturus gigas , reached roughly one meter in length and carried pincers more than 16 centimeters long. Around 415 million years ago, it would have been an imposing predator in the floodplain environments of the Early Devonian.

A study published in Palaeontology used modern analytical methods and comparisons with more recently described fossil species to determine that Praearcturus was a scorpion and represented a distinct species.

Dr. Richard J. Howard, Curator of Fossil Arthropods at the Natural History Museum, London, and lead author of the study, said: "When we think of giant arthropods, people often picture Carboniferous rainforests with giant millipedes or dragonfly-like insects from later in Earth's history. But Praearcturus lived at least 50 million years earlier, well before the evolution of trees, when life on land was only just getting started.

"Confirming that this animal is a scorpion fundamentally changes our understanding of how and when these creatures evolved to such extraordinary sizes."

The discovery pushes the story of giant arthropods much further back in time than the period usually associated with enormous insects and other invertebrates.

Dr. Russell Garwood, Paleontologist at The University of Manchester, added: " Praearcturus has puzzled us paleontologists for more than a century. By bringing together material from several collections and using cutting-edge imaging techniques, we've been able to build a clearer picture of the animal than was previously possible, which is really exciting.

"What makes Praearcturus so interesting is that it became enormous at a time when life on land was otherwise very small. But it was a world that could somehow support a giant predator. To try and better understand this ancient world, we compared the size of fossil scorpions with other animals alive at the time. To reach such extraordinary sizes, and conclude that perhaps it lived in water, where life was bigger."

Praearcturus gigas lived during the Early Devonian, when terrestrial ecosystems were still in their infancy. Small plants and fungi had only recently begun spreading across the landscape, while forests and other complex land ecosystems had not yet developed.

That timing is important because Praearcturus lived before the high atmospheric oxygen levels associated with the later rise of forests. Those oxygen-rich conditions have often been linked to the enormous size of some later...

reflection.en: The discovery of Praearcturus gigas, a scorpion that reached a meter in length 415 million years ago, reminds us that the natural world holds profound lessons. As Job observed, the creatures of the earth can teach us much about the Creator's wisdom and power. This ancient predator, existing long before forests, invites us to marvel at the deep history of...
reflection.zh: 发现长达一米的蝎子 Praearcturus gigas，生活在 4.15 亿年前，提醒我们自然界蕴含着深刻的教训。正如约伯所观察到的，地上的生物可以教会我们许多关于创造者的智慧和能力。这种古老的捕食者，存在于森林出现很久之前，邀请我们惊叹于生命的深厚历史以及编织在受造物中的精巧设计。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Astronauts set out on rare all-female spacewalk
title.zh: 宇航员进行罕见的首次全女性太空行走

summary.en: For the sixth time in history, a team of two women completed a spacewalk outside the International Space Station.
summary.zh: 历史上第六次，一支由两名女性组成的团队完成了在国际空间站外的太空行走。

reflection.en: Two women ventured into the vastness of space, a testament to human ingenuity and collaboration. In the face of the immense cosmos, we are reminded of the psalmist's wonder: 'What is man that you are mindful of him?' Yet, in this very act of exploration, humanity asserts its unique place and God-given dignity.
reflection.zh: 两位女性踏入了浩瀚的太空，这是人类智慧与协作的证明。面对浩瀚的宇宙，我们被提醒诗人的惊叹：“人算什么，你竟顾念他？”然而，正是通过这次探索，人类彰显了其独特的地位和雅伟所赐予的尊严。

verse.textEn: What is mankind that you are mindful of them, human beings that you care for them?
verse.textZh: 人算什么，你竟顾念他？

title.en: Will your name be the next UK storm?
title.zh: 你的名字会是下一个英国风暴的名字吗？

summary.en: The list of storm names for the upcoming year has been released. The question is whether personal names will be featured on this list.
summary.zh: 下一年的风暴名称列表已经发布。问题是个人名字是否会出现在这个名单上。

reflection.en: Each year, a list of names is compiled for storms in the UK. This practice, while practical, touches on the human desire for order and recognition. Daniel's prophecy speaks of a time when knowledge will increase, and many will rush to and fro. In our age, this includes the proliferation of information and the systems we create to categorize and understand...
reflection.zh: 每年，英国都会为风暴编制一份名称列表。这种做法虽然实用，但触及了人类对秩序和认可的渴望。但以理的预言谈到知识增长的时代，许多人将往来奔走。在我们这个时代，这包括信息的泛滥以及我们为理解周围世界（甚至天气）而创建的分类系统。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Is Donald Trump 'supplying all that money' to Nasa?
title.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普是否“为美国宇航局提供了所有资金”？

summary.en: BBC Verify fact checks President Trump's funding claims about Nasa.
summary.zh: BBC Verify 事实核查了特朗普总统关于美国国家航空航天局（NASA）资金的说法。

reflection.en: When leaders make bold claims about funding and policy, it's crucial to seek out reliable information and expert analysis. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that 'where there is no guidance, a people falls, but in an abundance of counselors there is safety.' Fact-checking claims, especially those concerning significant public resources like NASA's budget, helps...
reflection.zh: 当领导人对资金和政策做出大胆声明时，寻求可靠信息和专家分析至关重要。《箴言》11:14 提醒我们：“在没有指导的地方，人民会跌倒，但在谋士众多之处，就有安全。” 事实核查这些说法，特别是涉及美国国家航空航天局（NASA）预算等重要公共资源时，有助于确保问责制和明智的管理。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Almost half of world’s farmers poisoned by pesticides every year, experts find
title.zh: 专家发现：近一半全球农民每年遭受农药中毒

summary.en: A study reveals that nearly half of the world's farmers experience pesticide poisoning annually, resulting in 11,000 deaths each year, with India bearing the brunt of nearly 60% of these fatalities. The research, based on data from 2006-2023, estimates 402-433 million cases of unintentional acute pesticide poisoning...
summary.zh: 一项研究显示，全球近一半的农民每年都会遭受农药中毒，每年导致11,000人死亡，其中印度占近60%的死亡人数。这项基于2006-2023年公开数据进行的研究估计，每年有4.02亿至4.33亿农民和农场工人遭受非故意急性农药中毒。

body.en: Study reveals that pesticide poisoning kills 11,000 people each year, with India accounting for nearly 60% of fatalities Almost half of the world’s farmers are poisoned by pesticides every single year, a study has found. Using publicly available data from 2006-2023, the study, which was commissioned by Pesticide Action Network , found there to be an estimated 402-433m cases of unintentional acute pesticide poisoning of farmers and farm workers every year. Continue reading...
body.zh: 研究显示，农药中毒每年导致 11,000 人死亡，其中印度占死亡人数的近 60%。一项研究发现，全球每年有近一半的农民因农药中毒。这项由农药行动网络委托进行的研究利用 2006 年至 2023 年的公开数据发现，每年估计有 4.02 亿至 4.33 亿农民和农场工人意外急性农药中毒病例。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This study paints a grim picture of the daily reality for millions of farmers, who face severe health risks from the very tools they use to sustain us. Their plight often goes unnoticed, a silent crisis affecting those who feed the world. We are called to lend our voices to their cause, advocating for safer conditions and greater protection for these...
reflection.zh: 这项研究描绘了数百万农民日常现实的严峻景象，他们面临着使用以维持我们生计的工具所带来的严重健康风险。他们的困境常常被忽视，这是一场影响着养活世界的人们的无声危机。我们被呼召为他们的事业发声，倡导更安全的环境和为这些重要的劳动者提供更大的保护。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

summary.zh: 这是《自然》杂志上发表的题为“内源性大麻素通过逆行增益控制促进奖赏参与”的研究的作者勘误。

reflection.en: Scientific inquiry, even with its necessary corrections, reflects a deep human drive to understand the intricate workings of the world around us. Job 12:7-9 reminds us that creation itself is a source of wisdom, and observing its mechanisms, like the role of endocannabinoids, can lead to profound insights. This ongoing pursuit of knowledge, though sometimes...
reflection.zh: 科学探究，即使需要必要的修正，也反映了人类理解周围世界复杂运作机制的深层驱动力。约伯记12:7-9提醒我们，创造本身就是智慧的源泉，观察其运作机制，例如内源性大麻素的作用，可以带来深刻的见解。这种持续的知识追求，尽管有时需要调整，却荣耀了创造主的旨意。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

Even when initial findings need adjustment, the pursuit of knowledge through careful observation and diligent work reflects a deep engagement with the created order. Such efforts, though complex, can ultimately lead to greater understanding and healing.
reflection.zh: 这篇关于白血病研究的科学勘误，凸显了发现过程中不断迭代的本质。即使最初的发现需要调整，通过仔细观察和勤奋工作来追求知识，也反映了对受造秩序的深刻投入。这样的努力，尽管复杂，最终可以带来更多的理解和治愈。

While the initial findings about warming and drought are being withdrawn, the process itself is a testament to the ongoing effort to understand our world, a journey marked by both discovery and revision. It reminds us that the quest for knowledge, though...

summary.en: Since the first recording of whale song in 1949, researchers have been fascinated by their complex vocalizations. As technology advances, scientists are deciphering these intricate patterns to better understand and protect whales from human-caused harm.
summary.zh: 自1949年首次录制鲸鱼歌声以来，研究人员一直被它们复杂的发声所吸引。随着技术的进步，科学家们正在破译这些复杂的模式，以更好地理解并保护鲸鱼免受人类的伤害。

As technology improves, scientists are decoding the intricate patterns that make different species’ vocalisations distinctive. Madeleine Finlay hears from Emma Bryce, a journalist who has spent months investigating human efforts to understand whale song. She explains how this knowledge could help us better protect whales from human-made harms. Credits: 1. Valeria Vergara/Raincoast Conservation Foundation 2. Footage courtesy of Raincoast Conservation Foundation - Obtained for research under SARA permit XMMS 4 2026 3. Video by Amanda Cotton/Project CETI 4. Footage courtesy of Valeria Vergara and GREMM. reflection.en: The deep sea holds mysteries, and the complex songs of whales are one of them. For decades, humans have listened, trying to understand. This pursuit of knowledge about creation mirrors the ancient truth that the heavens and earth declare the glory and wisdom of Yahweh, inviting us to observe and learn.
reflection.zh: 深海充满了奥秘，鲸鱼复杂的歌声便是其中之一。几十年来，人类一直在倾听，试图理解。这种对受造之物的求知欲，恰恰映照了古老的真理：诸天述说雅伟的荣耀，穹苍传扬祂的作为，邀请我们观察和学习。

verse.textEn: Since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities — his eternal power and divine nature — have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made.

title.en: ‘Superhuman’ AI tool spots heart disease in less than 2 seconds
title.zh: “超人”人工智能工具2秒内发现心脏病

summary.en: A new AI tool, trained on millions of routine ECGs, can detect heart disease in under two seconds by analyzing data beyond human visual capacity. This technology aims to expedite treatment for high-risk patients, potentially reducing the need for lengthy waits for echocardiograms.
summary.zh: 一款新的人工智能工具，通过对数百万份常规心电图进行训练，能在两秒内发现心脏病，其分析能力超越了人眼所能见的范畴。该技术旨在加快高风险患者的治疗进程，并可能减少对需要长时间等待的超声心动图检查的依赖。

body.en:
Doctors have developed a “superhuman” AI tool that can spot heart disease in less than two seconds.

The groundbreaking technology has been trained on millions of patients and works by extracting more information from a routine electrocardiogram (ECG) than the human eye can typically see.

The traditional ECG, which records electrical activity in the heart, including the rate and rhythm, has been a vital medical tool in diagnosing heart attacks and abnormal heart rhythms for a century.

But it cannot detect heart disease. That requires an echocardiogram, a type of ultrasound scan, which patients often have to wait months for.

Now a team have developed an AI tool that can spot signs of heart failure and heart valve disease – two of the most common forms of heart disease – from ECG results in “the blink of an eye”.

Details of the breakthrough, which could boost early diagnosis of heart disease, were presented to thousands of delegates at the European Society of Cardiology annual congress in Munich, the world’s largest heart conference.

Early diagnosis is vital for heart failure and heart valve disease, enabling those who need lifesaving medicines to be spotted sooner, before they become dangerously unwell.

The development is being seen as potentially significant, because ECGs are one of the most common tests in medicine, with about a billion performed worldwide each year.

In a trial involving 67,000 patients in the US, the AI tool was able to identify up to 81% of those who had heart failure, and up to 90% of those with heart valve disease.

Dr Sonya Babu-Narayan, a consultant cardiologist and clinical director of the British Heart Foundation (BHF), which funded the trial, said: “It is exciting to see that AI can now deliver a read-out from an ECG in what feels like the blink of an eye.

“Technology like the AI ECG in this research, which has the potential to identify high-risk patients early, will not detect everyone with a heart condition. But it could be a solution to help fast-track the patients who are most likely to have a heart abnormality. When it comes to the heart, earlier diagnosis and treatment saves and improves lives.”

The tech cannot be used on its own to definitively diagnose or rule out heart failure or heart valve disease, but it gives a very strong indication someone may have them.

Someone judged as highly likely to have either could be sent rapidly for an echocardiogram, rather than wait months on the standard waiting lists. That could mean a quicker diagnosis which would enable them to start treatment earlier.

Prof Fu Siong Ng, a professor of cardiology at Imperial College London, said: “Patients can often wait several months for a heart ultrasound scan after being referred for one by their doctor.

“This makes it exciting...
body.zh: 医生们开发出了一种“超人”的人工智能工具，可以在不到两秒的时间内发现心脏病。 这项突破性的技术已经在数百万患者身上进行了培训，其工作原理是从常规心电图 (ECG) 中提取比人眼通常可以看到的更多信息。 传统的心电图记录心脏的电活动，包括心率和节律，一个世纪以来一直是诊断心脏病和心律失常的重要医疗工具。 但它无法检测心脏病。这需要超声心动图（一种超声波扫描），患者通常需要等待数月。 现在，一个团队开发了一种人工智能工具，可以根据“眨眼间”的心电图结果发现心力衰竭和心脏瓣膜疾病（两种最常见的心脏病形式）的迹象。 这一突破的细节可以促进心脏病的早期诊断，在慕尼黑举行的欧洲心脏病学会年会上向数千名代表介绍了这一突破，这是世界上最大的心脏病会议。 早期诊断对于心力衰竭和心脏瓣膜疾病至关重要，使那些需要救生药物的人能够在出现危险的不适之前尽早发现。 这一发展被认为具有潜在的重大意义，因为心电图是医学中最常见的测试之一，全世界每年进行约十亿次。 在美国一项涉及 67,000 名患者的试验中，AI 工具能够识别出高达 81% 的心力衰竭患者和高达 90% 的心脏瓣膜疾病患者。 资助这项试验的英国心脏基金会 (BHF) 的心脏病专家兼临床主任索尼娅·巴布-纳拉扬 (Sonya Babu-Narayan) 博士表示：“令人兴奋的是，人工智能现在可以在眨眼的时间内读取心电图读数。 “这项研究中的人工智能心电图等技术有可能及早识别出高危患者，但无法检测出每个患有心脏病的人。但这可能是帮助快速追踪最有可能患有心脏异常的患者的解决方案。当涉及到心脏时，早期诊断和治疗可以挽救并改善生命。” 该技术不能单独用于明确诊断或排除心力衰竭或心脏瓣膜疾病，但它给出了一个非常强烈的迹象，表明某人可能患有这些疾病。 被判断为极有可能患有这两种疾病的人可以被迅速送去做超声心动图检查，而不是在标准等待名单上等待数月。这可能意味着更快的诊断，使他们能够更早地开始治疗。 伦敦帝国理工学院心脏病学教授 Fu Siong Ng 教授表示：“在医生推荐进行心脏超声扫描后，患者通常需要等待几个月才能进行心脏超声扫描。 “这让人兴奋......

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, as seen in this new tool's ability to diagnose heart disease, reflects a world where human knowledge and technical capabilities are accelerating. As we witness such profound leaps in understanding and application, we are reminded of the biblical observation that in the end times, 'many will run to and fro,...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，正如这款能诊断心脏病的工具所示，反映了一个人类知识和技术能力日益加速的世界。当我们见证理解和应用上的巨大飞跃时，我们不禁想起圣经中的观察——在末世，“许多人往来奔跑，知识也必增长”。这种技术进步为治疗和福祉带来了巨大的潜力，呼唤我们以智慧和怜悯之心来管理它。

title.en: Toyohiro Akiyama, first Japanese citizen and journalist in space, dies at 84
title.zh: 首位进入太空的日本公民、记者秋山丰宽去世，享年84岁

summary.en: Toyohiro Akiyama, the first Japanese citizen and journalist to travel to space, has died at the age of 84. He was known for his reports from orbit, including a humorous observation about Japanese tree frogs enjoying weightlessness.
summary.zh: 首位进入太空的日本公民兼记者秋山丰宽（Toyohiro Akiyama）已于8月26日去世，享年84岁。他以从太空发回的报道而闻名，其中包括关于日本树蛙享受失重状态的幽默观察。

body.en: The first Japanese citizen to launch into space, Toyohiro Akiyama was also the first commercially sponsored cosmonaut and the world's first journalist to file reports while on a spaceflight. Akiyama, 84, died last Wednesday , August 26, of lower gastrointestinal bleeding, news agencies in Japan reported. A funeral was held with his close relatives in attendance. As a correspondent for the Tokyo Broadcasting System (TBS), Akiyama was chosen out of his 162 fellow employees who applied to fly to space in celebration of the network's 40th anniversary. He trained at the Gagarin Cosmonaut Training Center in Star City, located outside of Moscow, and was assigned to the Soyuz TM-11 crew. Read full article Comments

reflection.en: Toyohiro Akiyama's journey to space as a journalist reminds us of humanity's persistent curiosity and our drive to explore the unknown. His reports from orbit, even the lighthearted ones about tree frogs, offer a unique perspective on our place in the vast universe. In awe of the cosmos, we are led to ponder our own significance, as Psalm 8:4 asks, 'What is...
reflection.zh: 秋山丰宽作为一名记者太空之旅，提醒着我们人类持久的好奇心和探索未知的驱动力。他从轨道上发回的报道，即使是关于树蛙的轻松趣闻，也为我们在浩瀚宇宙中的位置提供了独特的视角。当我们惊叹于宇宙时，我们不禁会思考自身的意义，正如诗篇8:4所问：“人算什么，你竟顾念他？”

Cook, who handed over to John Ternus on Tuesday, will be paid a base salary of $2m and $45m worth of shares . Half of the share award will be based on performance targets being met, while the remaining half will be paid out over four years. Continue reading...

reflection.en: The immense financial rewards associated with leadership in major corporations can be staggering. As individuals like Tim Cook receive significant compensation, it prompts reflection on the stewardship of such resources and the dedication required in demanding roles. Colossians 3:23 reminds us that whatever work we do, whether leading a global company or...
reflection.zh: 大型企业领导层相关的巨额经济回报令人震惊。当蒂姆·库克这样的个人获得丰厚报酬时，这促使人们反思如何管理这些资源以及在艰巨岗位上所需的奉献精神。《歌罗西书》3章23节提醒我们，无论我们做什么工作，无论是领导一家全球公司还是承担任何其他任务，都应该全心投入，如同事奉更高的目的。
