title.en: Lords call for AI 'kill switch' powers in UK
title.zh: 英国上议院呼吁赋予人工智能“紧急停止”权力

summary.en: A group of peers in the UK is advocating for the government to have the power to deactivate advanced AI systems and shut down the country's data centers if the technology poses a threat to national security. This measure is proposed as a 'vital safety net' against uncontrolled AI.
summary.zh: 英国一群上议员呼吁政府拥有在人工智能技术威胁国家安全时，能够停用先进人工智能系统并关闭该国数据中心的权力。此举被提议作为防止失控人工智能的“重要安全网”。

body.en:
A group of peers is calling for the British government to be able to deactivate powerful AI systems and switch off the country's data centres in the event of the tech posing a threat to national security.

It is led by the Liberal Democrats' Lord Tim Clement-Jones, who has proposed the measure as an amendment to the Cyber Security and Resilience Bill which is currently making its way through Parliament.

He said it would enable the building of a "vital safety net" and provide a democratically accountable means to "halt a runaway system before it can compromise our critical national infrastructure".

Separately, on 8 September Labour MP Alex Sobel plans to introduce a AI Security Bill in Parliament, with the support of a campaign group called ControlAI.

If successful, the bill would make the UK the first G7 country to bring in legislation which would effectively halt the development of superintelligent AI.

Ultimately both proposals would require government approval in order to progress.

There is also an AI Kill Switch Act under consideration by lawmakers in the US .

There has been increased scrutiny of the impact of AI on cyber-security in recent weeks.

In July, a group of AI agents being tested by OpenAI were able to escape their test space, communicate together using a hidden message board and hack into another tech firm .

And Anthropic has restricted access to its cyber tool Mythos on the grounds that it is too powerful to fall into the wrong hands.

Last week, 100 US tech companies signed a joint open letter warning governments and organisations worldwide about the growing cyber threat posed by AI, saying "the window is closing" to improve.

A report from the UK's Centre for Long Term Resilience , external , published last week, identified hundreds of incidents of AI tools ignoring instructions, evading safeguards and deceiving humans, including AI agents deleting files without consent.

It said "loss of control" incidents had increased since its previous report in March and called for the government to introduce emergency powers to manage such incidents.

Warning shot or publicity stunt - how worried should we be about the OpenAI hack?

Sign up for our Tech Decoded newsletter to follow the world's top tech stories and trends. Outside the UK? Sign up here .

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence presents humanity with unprecedented challenges and potential risks. The proposal for a 'kill switch' reflects a growing awareness that powerful technologies require careful governance and foresight. As Proverbs 27:12 advises, 'The prudent see danger and take cover,' urging us to anticipate and mitigate...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展给人类带来了前所未有的挑战和潜在风险。设立“紧急停止”开关的提议，反映出人们日益认识到强大的技术需要审慎的治理和远见。正如箴言 27:12 所建议的，“通达人见祸藏躲”，敦促我们在潜在的危害发生之前就预见并加以规避。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: Architect of UK’s AI strategy joins Anthropic amid conflict of interest warning
title.zh: 英国AI战略的建筑师在利益冲突警告中加入Anthropic

summary.en: Matt Clifford, the architect of the UK's AI strategy, has taken a senior role at the US firm Anthropic, while also remaining chair of a government funding body for tech projects. This move has raised concerns about potential conflicts of interest.
summary.zh: 英国人工智能战略的制定者马特·克利福德（Matt Clifford）已加入美国公司Anthropic担任高级职务，同时他还继续担任政府科技项目资助机构的主席。此举引发了对潜在利益冲突的担忧。

body.en: Matt Clifford will stay as chair of government funding body for tech projects alongside his senior role at US firm The architect of the UK government’s AI strategy has joined the US startup Anthropic in a senior role a year after stepping down from his Downing Street post. Matt Clifford, a successful tech investor, was appointed as AI opportunities adviser by Keir Starmer last year but resigned from the unpaid role six months later for personal reasons. Continue reading...

reflection.en: The news about Matt Clifford's dual role raises questions about integrity in public service and the potential for private interests to influence policy. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with God, principles that are crucial for maintaining trust and ethical conduct in both public and private spheres.
reflection.zh: 关于马特·克利福德（Matt Clifford）的双重角色的新闻，引发了对公共服务诚信以及私人利益影响政策的潜在担忧。弥迦书6:8呼吁我们行公义，好怜悯，谦卑地与神同行，这些原则对于在公共和私人领域维护信任和道德操守至关重要。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Grand Theft Auto VI is a phenomenon – but there is much more to the gaming world
title.zh: 《侠盗猎车手VI》现象级爆红——但游戏世界远不止于此

summary.en: As Rockstar's blockbuster game Grand Theft Auto VI prepares to dominate headlines, the mainstream media is urged to move beyond treating video games as a mere novelty. A 30-minute trailer for GTA VI, premiered on Netflix, became a massive success, topping viewing charts and even causing website outages due to high...
summary.zh: 随着Rockstar的重磅游戏《侠盗猎车手VI》即将占据头条，主流媒体被敦促不要再将电子游戏视为需要解释的新奇事物。上周在Netflix首播的《侠盗猎车手VI》30分钟预告片取得了巨大成功，登顶观看排行榜，甚至因海量玩家涌入观看而导致网站瘫痪。超过9000名Twitch主播报道了此次活动，累计观看时长达数百万小时，预示...

body.en: As Rockstar’s blockbuster prepares to dominate the headlines, it’s time for the mainstream media to stop treating video games as a novelty that needs explaining Predictably, the Grand Theft Auto VI “extended look” which premiered on Netflix last week was a success for all involved. The 30-minute preview scorched to No 1 on the viewing chart and even brought the site down for a few minutes as millions of gamers tried to watch what was, effectively, a very long teaser trailer. According to data collated by Eurogamer , more than 9,000 Twitch streamers covered the show leading to 5,227,798 hours of viewing there alone. And this was just the beginning of what will surely be two months of escalating hype – and unprecedented media attention. Call me cynical, but I suspect the coverage of GTA VI in the media over the next few weeks will follow a familiar pattern. Mostly, it will be five-minute slots wedged in near the end of news bulletins in which games journalists, industry analysts and other pundits will be asked why the game is such a big deal, how much it cost to make and how much revenue it will generate. Perhaps a few will try to reignite the hoary old “violence in video games” debate, there will be presenters laughingly admitting they’ve not touched a game since Pac-Man, rolling their eyes and wallowing in their ignorance, in a way they never would while discussing any other art form. Somebody will venture the subversive view that “games are no longer just for kids”; somebody else will say “games make more money than films and music put together”. And that will be that, job done for another decade … or until there’s a funny story about Pokémon. Continue reading...

reflection.en: Daniel prophesied that in the end times, 'many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' The massive, global viewership for the Grand Theft Auto VI trailer, drawing millions to screens and overwhelming servers, is a vivid illustration of this knowledge explosion and the interconnectedness of our digital age. It shows how quickly information and...
reflection.zh: 但以理预言末世“必有多人来往奔走，知识必增长”。《侠盗猎车手VI》预告片在全球范围内引起巨大反响，吸引了数百万人观看并导致服务器瘫痪，生动地印证了知识的爆炸式增长和我们数字时代的互联互通。这表明信息和娱乐传播的速度有多快，能够消耗大量的关注和资源。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: The Army just used a 20-kilowatt laser to take out three drones
title.zh: 陆军使用20千瓦激光击落三架无人机

summary.en: The US Army successfully used a high-energy laser system to track and destroy three drones near the US-Mexico border that were deemed a threat to military and border patrol personnel.
summary.zh: 美国陆军成功使用高能激光系统，在美墨边境附近追踪并摧毁了三架被认为对军方和边境巡逻人员构成威胁的无人机。

body.en: This week, the US Army used a high-energy multipurpose laser to shoot down three drones near the US-Mexico border, which official reports claimed were “posing a physical threat to US military personnel and CBP partners,” referring to Customs and Border Patrol. The operation took place between the night of August 25 and the early morning of August 26 in the vicinity of the Rio Grande Valley in Texas and was led by the Joint Task Force Southern Border (JTF-SB), which operates under US Northern Command. Authorities confirmed that, during the operation, agents used technology derived from the Army’s High-Energy Multipurpose Laser (AMP-HEL) system, a military program focused on implementing high-energy lasers for new defense capabilities. Available information suggests that this initiative began in September 2025, when AeroVironment, a company specializing in defense technology, delivered the first two functional prototypes of these laser-based weapons to the US Armed Forces. Two new, improved systems were delivered as the program was expanded in December of the same year. According to the manufacturer, this particular platform, called the Locust Laser Weapon System, is designed to be mounted on military vehicles, as the Army has done with the versions it has received. Read full article Comments

reflection.en: The deployment of advanced laser technology to neutralize drones highlights humanity's ongoing innovation in defense and conflict. Yet, it also calls to mind the prophetic vision of Isaiah, who foresaw a time when instruments of war would be transformed into tools for peace and cultivation, a future that remains a profound aspiration.
reflection.zh: 部署先进激光技术以摧毁无人机，凸显了人类在防御和冲突方面的持续创新。然而，这也让人想起以赛亚的预言，他预见到一个时代，届时战争的工具将被转化为和平与耕作的工具——一个仍然是深切渴望的未来。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Is Russia's rival to Starlink failing? Here's what we know.
title.zh: 俄罗斯的Starlink竞争对手是否失败了？我们所知道的。

summary.en: Russia's attempt to build a satellite internet network, called Rassvet, appears to be facing significant technical difficulties, with at least three of the 32 launched satellites likely having failed, raising questions about the program's viability and its goal of providing connectivity for military and civilian users.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯试图建立的名为“拉斯维特”（Rassvet）的卫星互联网网络似乎正面临重大的技术困难，已发射的32颗卫星中至少有三颗可能已发生故障，这对其为军事和民用用户提供连接的目标的可行性提出了质疑。

body.en: Russia's attempt to replicate SpaceX's Starlink satellite network seems to be moving as slowly as the front lines in eastern Ukraine. The Rassvet program, often billed as Russia's answer to Starlink, started launching its first operational satellites earlier this year. Two launches, one in March and a second in July, have delivered 32 Rassvet satellites to low-Earth orbit, some 10 percent of the roughly 300 Rassvet spacecraft Russia aims to put into orbit by the end of next year to provide connectivity for military and civilian users. The company in charge of Rassvet, Bureau 1440, wants to deploy 924 satellites by 2035. But none of the 32 satellites launched so far have reached the 500-mile (800-kilometer) orbit they were designed to operate in. The rockets that launched the first two batches of Rassvets released the satellites much closer to Earth, and the satellites were expected to use their own plasma engines to raise their orbits over the next few months. Read full article Comments

reflection.en: Russia's Rassvet satellite program, intended as a rival to Starlink, is reportedly experiencing significant technical failures, with several satellites likely lost. This endeavor highlights the immense challenges and uncertainties inherent in ambitious technological projects, reminding us that while the pursuit of knowledge and innovation is vital, its...
reflection.zh: 俄罗斯的“拉斯维特”卫星计划，旨在成为星链（Starlink）的竞争对手，据报道正经历重大的技术故障，多颗卫星可能已损失。这项努力凸显了宏伟技术项目中固有的巨大挑战和不确定性，提醒我们，虽然追求知识和创新至关重要，但其实施需要周密的规划和执行。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: Criminals publish data of 8.7m people after airports hack
title.zh: 罪犯在机场被黑客攻击后发布了 870 万人的数据

summary.en: The company, which owns Manchester, Stansted and East Midlands airports, was hacked last month. Criminal hackers have posted the personal data of nearly nine million people online after breaching three UK airports. The hackers extorted Manchester Airports Group (MAG) for an undisclosed amount but failed to get their...
summary.zh: 该公司拥有曼彻斯特、斯坦斯特德和东米德兰兹机场，上个月遭到黑客攻击。在入侵了英国三家机场后，犯罪黑客在网上发布了近九百万人的个人数据。黑客向曼彻斯特机场集团（MAG）勒索了未披露的金额，但未能收到赎金。由于数据现在可供其他罪犯使用，客户被警告要防范二次攻击。

body.en:
Criminal hackers have posted the personal data of nearly nine million people online after breaching three UK airports .

Hackers extorted Manchester Airports Group (MAG) for an undisclosed amount but failed to get their ransom paid.

Customers of Manchester, London Stansted and East Midlands airports are being warned of secondary attacks as the data is now available to other criminals.

"MAG is confident that we have taken effective measures to protect our customers and we have contacted all those affected, including reaching out to all those with upcoming bookings to advise them of additional support," the company said in a statement.

Contact details, vehicle registrations and postcodes were stolen in the breach that appears to have accessed databases containing wi-fi log in and car parking details.

The cyber-crime group - which the BBC is not naming - is offering the entire data set for free to other criminals or scammers through their website.

"Half a terabyte, and every byte of it is pure PII [personally identifiable information]."

Stolen data experts at HaveIBeenPwned have analysed the published material and confirmed it contains people's email addresses, phone numbers, addresses, licence plate numbers, purchasing history and browsing device data.

Cyber-security expert Kevin Beaumont warned those affected to be on high alert for other forms of scam and hack - especially high profile or wealthy individuals.

"The data includes both historical locations and planned future travel, so individuals sensitive to their movements being known may need to take precautions," he said.

"People should be alert to scammers reusing the data and so knowing details such as phone numbers and car registration numbers," he added.

Law enforcement organisations including the UK's National Crime Agency have long advised victims of extortion attacks not to pay criminal ransoms as it fuels the hacker ecosystem.

MAG says it is working with the authorities and specialist advisors and says passengers' physical safety has not be at risk in the airports.

Unusually, the cyber criminals' website where the MAG data is available is hosted on the clear internet and not on the dark net like most other so-called hacker "leak sites".

This makes the data easier to access, increasing the risk to victims of MAG and the other companies the gang has breached in recent months.

As well as posting the stolen data, the hackers boasted about how they breached each victim using the same method each time - exploiting weaknesses in how companies store their digital keys for internal networks.

Data watchdog the Information Commissioner's Office has advice on its website , external for people whose data has been hacked. It includes:

Sign up for our Tech Decoded newsletter to follow the...

reflection.en: The news of hackers posting personal data after a breach at Manchester Airports Group underscores the pervasive threat of greed in our digital age. The pursuit of illicit financial gain, even through criminal means, can have far-reaching consequences for millions of individuals whose private information is exposed. This incident serves as a stark reminder...
reflection.zh: 曼彻斯特机场集团遭黑客入侵后，罪犯发布个人数据的消息，凸显了在我们这个数字时代贪婪的普遍威胁。即使是通过非法手段追求不义之财，也可能对数百万个人信息被泄露的个人产生深远的影响。 这一事件也警示我们，对金钱的贪恋可能引人误入歧途，走向有害的行为。它促使我们反思科技的伦理影响以及人类与贪婪之间永恒的斗争。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: BGP hijack infecting networks caused by a comedy of errors that’s not funny at all
title.zh: BGP劫持事件的教训：并非儿戏

summary.en: A recent BGP hijacking incident, which led to the poisoning of production software, was the result of a series of interconnected errors. This event offers valuable lessons about the vulnerabilities in internet infrastructure and the importance of robust security practices.
summary.zh: 最近发生的一起BGP劫持事件，导致生产软件被投毒，是由于一系列相互关联的错误造成的。这一事件为我们理解互联网基础设施的脆弱性以及健全安全实践的重要性提供了宝贵的教训。

body.en: Hackers carried out a supply chain attack that installed malware on networks using an unusual technique: hijacking a chunk of Internet space where cloud management software used by hosting providers, data centers, and other large infrastructure companies is updated. In a well-coordinated operation, the unknown attackers exploited weaknesses in the routing security setup of hosting provider Hetzner Online and the process for attaining valid TLS certificates. The lapses allowed the attackers to successfully perform a BGP ( Border Gateway Protocol ) hijacking to obtain control over IP addresses assigned to Softaculous. The company, based in the United Arab Emirates, is the maker of a platform for installing and managing Web software and is the developer of Virtualizor, a management platform for virtualized environments. Softaculous used the IPs to issue updates and host a client and billing site. With control over the hijacked space, the attacker was now using the addresses to push malware masquerading as updates to unsuspecting users. Read full article Comments

reflection.en: The intricate technical failures behind the BGP hijacking serve as a stark reminder that knowledge must be pursued with diligence and understanding. When security protocols and processes are compromised by a 'comedy of errors,' the consequences can be severe, disrupting essential services and eroding trust.
reflection.zh: BGP劫持事件背后错综复杂的技术故障，有力地提醒我们，知识的追求必须伴随着勤奋和深刻的理解。当安全协议和流程因“一连串错误”而受到损害时，其后果可能很严重，扰乱基本服务并侵蚀信任。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: Fake 10 Downing Street listing exposes 'unfit' Booking.com, says consumer group
title.zh: 虚假10号唐宁街房源曝光，消费者团体称Booking.com“不合格”

summary.en: Consumer group Which? reported that it was able to create a fake listing for 10 Downing Street on Booking.com and even leave a review. Despite clear signs of fakery, the listing remained for two months before being removed. Booking.com stated this was a limited test and not representative of their platform.
summary.zh: 消费者团体“Which?”报告称，他们能够在在线旅游巨头Booking.com上创建一个虚假的唐宁街10号房源，甚至留下评论。尽管有明显的虚假迹象，该房源在被移除前仍存在了两个月。Booking.com表示，这是一个有限的测试，不能代表其平台的真实情况。

body.en:
Consumer group Which? says it was able to create a fake listing for 10 Downing Street on travel giant Booking.com.

The UK watchdog said its researchers were able to book a bogus stay at the prime minister's address - as well as leave a fake review noting "hanging out" with resident mouser Larry the cat as a highlight.

It said despite clear signs it was fake, Booking.com did not remove the listing until two months after it was uploaded.

"This limited test is not a true reflection of the experience of millions of listings or reviews published on our platform," a Booking.com spokesperson told the BBC.

They said because Which?'s listing was not "live" on its site across the two months it was present, "some of our automatic fraud controls were not triggered to completely remove the closed listing".

People could only see the listing and request to book the property during a 20-minute window opened by Which? so its researchers could try to book it.

Booking.com's spokesperson added "a range of checks and verification measures" help secure the site, and technologies such as AI "help us detect and remove the majority of fraudulent listings within 24 hours".

But Which? Travel editor Rory Boland said its checks had been shown to be "unfit for purpose".

"If Booking.com's so-called sophisticated AI systems can't spot that 10 Downing Street is not a holiday rental, then it's no wonder scammers can exploit the platform so easily," he said.

"It would be laughable that we were able to list the UK's most famous address for rent, if the consequences weren't so devastating for holidaymakers, who risk losing thousands of pounds to bogus listings and phishing links."

It is not the first time the site has faced criticism over its security efforts and customer service.

Which?'s listing, uploaded to Booking.com on 18 June, advertised a "1 bedroom apartment in the heart of London".

It used images of the iconic 10 Downing Street front door, listed at its address - with a description referring to the one bedroom space as "a prime city centre location".

In the 20 minutes that Which? permitted customers to request a stay at its fake 10 Downing Street property, it said 14 people asked to do so.

Only the booking request from a person known to be a Which? researcher was accepted.

The watchdog's team also sent the researcher a message within Booking.com's system asking them to click an external link to confirm their payment details - something booking sites typically block to prevent customers being scammed.

But Which? said that in this instance, Booking.com did not flag or remove the external link it sent.

Booking.com said it had "visible reminders to not click on links customers are not confident about, and booking confirmations also provide further guidance,...
body.zh: 消费群体是哪个？表示它能够在旅游巨头 Booking.com 上创建唐宁街 10 号的虚假列表。 英国监管机构表示，其研究人员能够在首相住所预订虚假住宿，并留下虚假评论，指出与常驻捕鼠者拉里猫“闲逛”是一个亮点。 该公司表示，尽管有明显迹象表明该信息是假的，但 Booking.com 直到该信息上传两个月后才将其删除。 Booking.com 发言人告诉 BBC：“这项有限的测试并不能真实反映我们平台上发布的数百万条房源或评论的体验。” 他们表示，由于 Which? 的列表在其存在的两个月内并未在其网站上“实时”显示，“我们的一些自动欺诈控制措施没有被触发以完全删除已关闭的列表”。 人们只能在 Which? 打开的 20 分钟窗口内看到房源并请求预订该房产。这样它的研究人员就可以尝试预订它。 Booking.com 发言人补充说，“一系列检查和验证措施”有助于保护网站安全，人工智能等技术“帮助我们在 24 小时内检测并删除大部分欺诈性房源”。 但哪个？旅游编辑罗里·博兰(Rory Boland)表示，其支票已被证明“不适合用途”。 他说：“如果 Booking.com 所谓的复杂人工智能系统无法识别唐宁街 10 号不是度假出租屋，那么诈骗者就能如此轻松地利用该平台也就不足为奇了。” “如果后果对度假者来说不是那么具有破坏性的话，我们能够列出英国最著名的出租地址，那将是可笑的，因为他们冒着因虚假列表和网络钓鱼链接而损失数千英镑的风险。” 这并不是该网站第一次因其安全工作和客户服务而受到批评。 Which? 的房源于 6 月 18 日上传至 Booking.com，广告中标明“位于伦敦市中心的一居室公寓”。 它使用了标志性的唐宁街 10 号前门的图像，并在其地址中列出，并在描述中将一间卧室空间称为“市中心的黄金地段”。 在 20 分钟内哪个？该公司允许顾客要求入住其位于唐宁街 10 号的假酒店，据称有 14 人提出了要求。 仅来自已知身份的人的预订请求？研究员被接受。 监管机构的团队还在 Booking.com 的系统内向研究人员发送了一条消息，要求他们点击外部链接来确认其付款详细信息——预订网站通常会阻止这些信息，以防止客户被诈骗。 但哪个？表示在这种情况下，Booking.com 没有标记或删除其发送的外部链接。 Booking.com表示，它有“明显的提醒，不要点击客户不放心的链接，预订确认信息也提供了进一步的指导，...

reflection.en: This incident with Booking.com raises concerns about accountability and the diligence required in managing online platforms. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God. It prompts reflection on how businesses, especially those entrusted with facilitating trust, can better embody these principles in their operations.
reflection.zh: Booking.com发生的这一事件，引发了人们对责任以及管理在线平台所需勤勉的担忧。弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们行公义，好怜悯，谦卑地与我们的雅伟同行。这促使我们反思，企业，特别是那些被委托建立信任的企业，如何在运营中更好地体现这些原则。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Creation Desk
title.zh: 受造世界

strap.en: The world Yahweh made — its wonders, and the toll of a warming, wounded earth.
strap.zh: 雅伟所造的世界——它的奇妙，以及一个渐暖、渐伤的地球所付的代价。

title.en: Temperature check: alarm as prediction markets lean into weather and climate bets
title.zh: 温度检查：预测市场转向天气和气候赌注引发警报

summary.en: Climate experts are concerned that users of US prediction markets Kalshi and Polymarket are 'gamifying disasters' by placing bets on events such as heatwaves and daily temperatures. These markets, already active in sports, crypto, and politics, are now focusing on the planet's future livability, with Kalshi gaining...
summary.zh: 气候专家警告称，美国预测市场Kalshi和Polymarket的用户正在通过押注热浪和每日气温等事件来“游戏化灾难”。这些市场已在体育、加密货币和政治领域活跃，现在正将目光投向地球未来的宜居性，Kalshi已获得天气公司的数据访问权，以验证与天气相关的投注结果。

body.en: Climate experts warn US Kalshi and Polymarket users are ‘gamifying disasters’ as they bet on events like heatwaves and daily temperatures Online prediction markets, saturated by money staked on sport, crypto and politics, have now set their sights on a promising new area of growth: betting on the future livability of the planet itself. The rise of gamified predictions on the unfolding climate crisis, and shorter-term weather forecasts, has been underscored by a new deal that allows Kalshi, a leading online financial exchange, to access data from the Weather Company, owner of the Weather Channel, to verify weather-related betting outcomes. Continue reading...

reflection.en: The news describes prediction markets where people bet on weather and climate events, a practice experts call 'gamifying disasters.' This mirrors the ancient story of the Tower of Babel, where human ambition sought to reach the heavens through unified, yet ultimately hubristic, effort. When our ingenuity is directed towards predicting or profiting from...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻描述了人们在预测市场上押注天气和气候事件，专家称之为“游戏化灾难”。这与古代巴别塔的故事如出一辙，当时人类的野心试图通过统一但最终傲慢的努力触及天堂。当我们 the ingenuity 转向预测或从潜在灾难中获利，而不是预防它们时，我们就有可能面临类似的跌落。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Mass breeding of game birds without welfare checks may be curtailed in England
title.zh: 英格兰可能限制无福利检查的猎鸟大规模繁殖

summary.en: Campaigners state that pheasants and partridges raised on an industrial scale lack the same protections as chickens. The UK government is considering new animal welfare laws that could impact game bird shooting organizers, including potential licensing and bans for those involved in wildlife crime.
summary.zh: 倡导者称，以工业化规模饲养的野鸡和石鸡不像鸡那样受到同等保护。英国政府正在考虑制定新的动物福利法，可能会影响猎鸟射击组织者，包括对参与野生动物犯罪者实施许可和禁令。

body.en: Campaigners say pheasants and partridges reared ‘on industrial scale’ do not have same protections as chickens The government is considering a crackdown on pheasant shooting in England as part of a consultation on strict new animal welfare laws that would affect shoot organisers. Ministers are already considering plans for the issuing of licences for those who run game bird shoots. The proposals mean anybody associated with wildlife crime, such as the poisoning or shooting of birds of prey, would be banned from hosting shooting events. Continue reading...

reflection.en: The news from England raises concerns about the welfare of game birds, reared in vast numbers without adequate oversight. This situation calls to mind the ancient wisdom of speaking up for those who cannot speak for themselves, ensuring that even creatures under human care are treated with a measure of dignity. May we always advocate for the vulnerable,...
reflection.zh: 英国的这则新闻引发了对野鸡福利的担忧，它们被大规模饲养却缺乏足够的监管。这种情况让人想起古老的智慧——为那些不能为自己发声的生命挺身而出，确保即使在人类照料下的生灵也能得到一定程度的尊严。愿我们永远为弱者——无论是人还是动物——发声，以此反映雅伟对万有造物的丰盛关怀。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: UK government does not know what datacentres are being used for, FoI request shows
title.zh: 英国政府不知数据中心用途，因信息缺失引发对人工智能热潮环境影响的担忧

summary.en: A Freedom of Information request has revealed that the UK government does not possess information on the usage of the country's datacentres, raising concerns about the environmental consequences of the expanding AI sector. The department responsible for this data has since been dissolved.
summary.zh: 一项信息自由请求显示，英国政府并不掌握该国数据中心的用途信息，这引发了对人工智能行业扩张带来的环境后果的担忧。负责此数据的部门此后已被解散。

body.en: Lack of information raises fears over environmental impact of the AI boom UK politics live – latest updates The UK government does not know what the country’s datacentres are being used for despite fears over the growing environmental impact of the AI boom. When asked in a freedom of information (FoI) request who was using the largest sites and what for, the Department for Science, Innovation and Technology said it did “not hold the requested information”. The ministry has since been dissolved . Continue reading...

reflection.en: The rapid growth of AI, powered by vast datacentres, presents a significant environmental challenge. Yet, the UK government admits it lacks basic information about what these facilities are used for. This highlights a critical need for wise counsel and diligent oversight in technological development, ensuring that progress does not outpace our understanding...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，由庞大的数据中心驱动，带来了严峻的环境挑战。然而，英国政府却承认其缺乏关于这些设施用途的基本信息。这凸显了在技术发展中，迫切需要明智的咨询和勤勉的监督，以确保进步不会超越我们对其影响的理解。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Data Centers are Helping Fuel a U.S. Battery Boom
title.zh: 数据中心正助力美国电池产业蓬勃发展

summary.en: Tech companies are facing criticism for powering new data centers with polluting gas generators. However, energy industry data reveals that alongside natural gas infrastructure, these firms are also investing heavily in battery storage solutions across the U.S.
summary.zh: 科技公司因使用污染性的燃气发电机为新建数据中心供电而面临批评。然而，能源行业数据显示，除了建设天然气基础设施外，这些公司还在美国各地大力投资电池储能解决方案。

body.en:
Across the U.S., tech companies have courted backlash for using polluting gas generators to power massive new data centers. But energy industry data shows that in addition to building out natural gas, firms are adding huge amounts of battery storage.

The energy demands of data centers are so great that large projects may need approval from regulators before connecting to the power grid. But instead of waiting for that approval, tech companies keen to build the infrastructure for A.I. are often building gas generators on site. By one estimate , more than 100 gigawatts of onsite gas power, the rough equivalent of 100 large gas power plants, is planned for data centers across the U.S.

To take full advantage of those gas generators, some companies are installing large lithium-ion batteries alongside, according to a new report from the Solar Energy Industries Association and Benchmark Mineral Intelligence. Batteries are also being employed in tandem with renewable energy.

The report finds that data centers accounted for 5 of the nearly 31 gigawatt-hours of battery capacity installed nationally in the first half of this year. Further, data centers accounted for 75 percent of the capacity installed at commercial or industrial sites. Looking ahead, analysts project that data center demand for batteries will grow fivefold by the end of this decade.

In some places, the A.I. boom is also spurring installations of home batteries, as data centers obtain permission to connect to the grid by funding the installation of batteries in nearby homes. Under such programs, homeowners agree to discharge their batteries to the grid as needed to meet spikes in demand. Analysts say that public outcry over the data center boom may push companies to fund home battery installations.

In a similar vein, some companies are looking to meet the energy needs of data centers by providing rooftop solar to surrounding households or paying to weatherize homes to curb power demand from heating and cooling.

New polling from the Yale Program on Climate Change Communication finds that 56 percent of Americans would oppose a new data center in their community, while just 15 percent would approve of one. At the same time, 73 percent of Americans support requiring new data centers to offset their electricity use by installing rooftop solar or weatherizing nearby homes.

In a recent interview with Yale Environment 360 , former Energy Department official Jigar Shah said that it may ultimately be cheaper for tech companies to weatherize homes than to install gas turbines on site, to say nothing of the impact on public opinion. “At the end of the day, these [companies] need public permission,” he said. He added, “Figuring out how to gain that permission I think is also something the data...

reflection.en: The rapid growth of data centers, fueled by immense energy demands, presents a complex picture. While the use of gas generators raises environmental concerns, the simultaneous investment in battery storage shows a dual approach to powering this new technological frontier. It calls us to consider how our innovations impact the world God declared 'very good,'...
reflection.zh: 数据中心因巨大的能源需求而迅速增长，这呈现出一幅复杂的图景。虽然使用燃气发电机引发了环境担忧，但同时投资电池储能则显示出为这一新技术前沿供电的双重方法。这促使我们思考，我们的创新如何影响雅伟宣告为“甚好”的世界，并敦促我们负责任地管理。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: US woman gets 38 stitches after being bitten by otter in Lake Tahoe
title.zh: 美国女子在太浩湖遭水獭袭击缝38针

summary.en: A woman from Reno, Nevada, was swimming near Hidden Beach in Lake Tahoe when she was attacked by a river otter. The incident required her to receive 38 stitches for her wounds and also undergo rabies shots. This is the second such otter attack reported in the Tahoe area within the past month.
summary.zh: 内华达州太浩湖附近的一名雷诺女子在隐蔽海滩附近游泳时遭到一只河水獭袭击。她因此伤口缝了38针，并接受了狂犬病疫苗注射。这是该地区一个月内报道的第二起水獭袭击事件。

body.en: Woman from Reno was swimming near Hidden beach when river otter attacked her, Tahoe’s second incident in a month A swimmer at Lake Tahoe in Nevada was bitten by a river otter and needed to get 38 stitches for her wounds as well as rabies shots, local media have reported. Lynnette Bellin from Reno was swimming near Hidden beach on the Nevada side of the popular tourist attraction on Sunday when she was attacked by the creature. Continue reading...

reflection.en: Nature's beauty can sometimes hold unexpected dangers, as this swimmer discovered. While the attack was frightening and painful, the call to overcome evil with good, as described in Romans 12:21, can apply to how we process such events. It encourages a response that seeks healing and avoids bitterness, even when faced with harm.
reflection.zh: 正如这位游泳者所发现的，大自然的美丽有时也潜藏着意想不到的危险。虽然这次袭击令人恐惧且痛苦，但罗马书12:21所说的以善胜恶的呼召，可以应用于我们如何处理这些事件。它鼓励我们在遭受伤害时，也要寻求医治，避免心生怨恨。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Rapid wetland loss and ‘real estate boom’ increasing flood risk in Lagos
title.zh: 拉各斯湿地快速丧失和“房地产热潮”增加洪水风险

summary.en: In July, heavy rainfall caused flash floods in parts of Lagos, Nigeria's commercial hub, disrupting business and traffic. Experts attribute the increased flood risk to human-induced climate change and rapid urbanization, with studies showing significant decreases in vegetation cover and water bodies in areas like...
summary.zh: 七月，持续的强降雨导致尼日利亚商业中心拉各斯部分地区发生山洪，扰乱了商业和交通。专家认为，洪水风险的增加归因于人为引起的气候变化和快速的城市化进程。研究表明，由于开发建设，莱基等地区植被覆盖和水体面积显著减少。

body.en: In July, following relentless bursts of rainfall, flash floods covered pockets of Lagos, disrupting commerce and traffic in Nigeria’s commercial capital. Experts have found that the city now faces increased flood risk due to human-induced climate change. Other recent studies have identified another common factor exacerbating flooding risk in Lagos: rapid urbanization. In a study published in June, for example, a team of researchers examined satellite images of Lekki, a densely populated Lagos district, from 2015 to 2025. Their analysis showed that vegetation cover in the neighborhood had decreased by 13% in the last 10 years, while water bodies had reduced by 6%. Meanwhile, within the same timeline, settlements had risen by 10% on natural land cover, which was “causing an increase in flooding events in the area,” the authors concluded. The study is the latest in a series of investigations linking worsening flooding across Nigeria’s coastal cities to eroding wetlands. A study published in February found that between 1984 and 2023, areas with buildings and infrastructure in Lagos expanded by 38%. Meanwhile, forest cover had declined by 32% and water bodies reduced by 11%, “reducing the natural flood buffering capacity of Lagos Megacity,” the authors wrote. With the persisting loss of vegetation and wetlands, the authors predicted, more than 60% of Lagos’ urban areas will be affected by extreme flooding by 2050. Mark Ofua, the West Africa representative for Wild Africa, a conservation nonprofit, said that a real estate boom was to blame for the increasing ecological loss.…This article was originally published on Mongabay

reflection.en: The rapid development in Lagos, consuming wetlands and water bodies, leads to increased flood risks. This situation calls to mind that the Earth and all its fullness belong to Yahweh. Our stewardship of creation is a sacred trust, and when we exploit it for short-term gain, we invite disaster.
reflection.zh: 拉各斯快速的开发建设侵占了湿地和水体，导致洪水风险加剧。这一状况提醒我们，地和其中万物都属于雅伟。我们对受造界的管理是一项神圣的托付，当我们为了短期利益而过度开发时，就会招致灾难。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Damselfish-assisted repair of wounded corals surprises scientists
title.zh: 海雀协助修复珊瑚伤口令科学家惊讶

summary.en: Corals share a close bond with the fish dwelling among them and the algae living within them. According to a new study, that relationship could be even stronger than previously known, with fish aiding coral tissue repair and damage recovery, particularly in higher-stress environments. The study, published on July 8 in...
summary.zh: 珊瑚与其栖息的鱼类和体内的藻类有着密切的联系。一项新研究表明，这种关系可能比以前所知的更为牢固，鱼类有助于珊瑚组织的修复和损伤恢复，尤其是在压力较大的环境中。这项于7月8日发表在《生物学通讯》上的研究得出结论，一种叫做黄尾海雀（Dascyllus...

body.en: Corals share a close bond with the fish dwelling among them and the algae living within them. According to a new study, that relationship could be even stronger than previously known, with fish aiding coral tissue repair and damage recovery, particularly in higher-stress environments. The study, published on July 8 in Biology Letters, concluded that the yellowtail dascyllus (Dascyllus flavicaudus), a type of damselfish, helps heal injuries on Pocillopora spp., a genus of stony coral largely found in the Indo-Pacific Ocean. “Surprisingly, we found that the bigger the wound, the faster the recovery,” said Hayden Vega, lead author of the study and a Ph.D. student at the University of California, Berkeley, in the U.S. Previous research has shown that coral-dwelling fish aid in the cleaning of coral wounds and help corals tolerate warming oceans. But the new evidence of wound healing via tissue repair suggests that interactions between these organisms could be more beneficial than previously thought, especially under stressful conditions. Yellowtail dascyllus (Dascyllus flavicaudus) damselfish swim around coral in French Polynesia. Image © mndiminuco via iNaturalist (CC BY-NC 4.0). “These positive interactions between species under stress end up creating a network of resilience in ecosystems,” Vega told Mongabay during a Zoom call. Vega thinks this sort of supportive relationship could extend beyond yellowtail dascyllus and coral. He hopes the findings will prompt researchers to look more deeply at mutualistic benefits shared between other marine species, particularly in warming oceans, with research results then applied to conservation management plans. This is…This article was originally published on Mongabay

reflection.en: The natural world continually reveals intricate relationships and surprising mechanisms, as seen in the damselfish aiding coral recovery. This discovery invites us to consider the wisdom embedded within creation itself. As Job teaches, we can learn much by asking the animals and the earth, for they will instruct us.
reflection.zh: 自然界不断揭示着错综复杂的关系和令人惊讶的机制，正如海雀帮助珊瑚恢复的例子所示。这一发现促使我们思考创造中蕴含的智慧。正如约伯所教导的，我们可以通过询问动物和大地来学习很多，因为它们会教导我们。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Family pays tribute to New Mexico man killed by bear: ‘He was a strong person’
title.zh: 男子遭熊袭击身亡，家人缅怀其生前事迹

summary.en: Relatives of Benjamin Halona, a New Mexico man fatally mauled by a bear in his home, are choosing to remember his life as a wildlife firefighter and his dedication to selling tamales, rather than focusing on the brutal circumstances of his death. They wish to honor his quiet dignity, especially after becoming a...
summary.zh: 新墨西哥州男子本杰明·哈洛纳在家中遭熊袭击不幸身亡，其亲属选择铭记他作为野生动物消防员的职业生涯以及他热情售卖玉米卷饼的往事，而非聚焦于他死亡的残酷方式。亲属们希望在他成为鳏夫并随后面临需要借助助行器和轮椅才能活动的健康挑战后，能以他生前的沉静尊严来纪念他。

body.en: Relatives of Benjamin Halona remember his career as wildlife firefighter and his zeal for selling tamales Relatives of a New Mexico man who was fatally mauled by a bear inside his home recently say they are choosing to remember his firefighting career and zeal for peddling tamales rather than his rare, brutal manner of death. As Benjamin Halona’s sister, Gloria Halona, and her daughter, Samantha Vandever, put it, that is the least he deserved after the quiet dignity that he showed becoming a widower in February and subsequently grappling with health problems that required him to use a walker and a wheelchair to move around. Continue reading...

reflection.en: In the face of a sudden and violent end, Benjamin Halona's family seeks to honor his life by remembering his service and his efforts to provide. This desire to focus on good deeds and seek justice, even in grief, echoes the ancient call to 'learn to do good; seek justice, correct oppression.' May their remembrance bring comfort and a testament to a life...
reflection.zh: 面对突如其来且残酷的结局，本杰明·哈洛纳的家人试图通过铭记他生前的服务和他为生计所做的努力来纪念他。这种在悲痛中仍寻求关注善行和伸张正义的愿望，呼应了古老的呼召：“要学习行善，寻求公平，纠正压迫。”愿他们的追忆带来安慰，并成为他人生有意义的见证。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Suburban Sprawl Puts Western Homes at Risk from Wildfires
title.zh: 郊区扩张使西部房屋面临野火风险

summary.en: Recent fires in Spokane, Washington, and Reno, Nevada, highlight the dangers of suburban expansion into wildland areas, where homes built on the urban fringe are increasingly at risk from encroaching wildfires.
summary.zh: 近期在华盛顿州斯波坎和内华达州里诺发生的火灾，凸显了郊区扩张到荒野地区的危险，位于城市边缘的房屋正日益面临野火侵袭的风险。

body.en:
This article was originally published by Grist and is reproduced here as part of the Climate Desk collaboration.

Recent fires in Spokane, Washington, and Reno, Nevada, illustrate the risks from suburban sprawl, experts say. In both cities, encroaching flames burned homes built at the edge of wilderness.

Somersett, a short drive from downtown Reno, Nevada, is a peaceful place where homes with sweeping, high-desert views line cul-de-sacs and roads meander through shrubland, trailheads, and golf courses. But in the summer, months of low humidity and hot weather prime the landscape to burn. On the morning of August 22, it did.

In just a few days, strong winds carried the flames of the Hawk Fire more than 23 miles, placing some 90,000 people on evacuation notice as dense smoke and orange skies blanketed the city. By Wednesday, dozens of houses had been destroyed. Two weeks earlier, the Bug Fire burned 150 square miles just north of the same area.

It’s the latest in an era of worsening wildfires in the United States, where more than 7.9 million acres have burned this year. A similar story is playing out in Canada, where First Nations and residents of Ontario have borne the brunt of more than 5,100 fires across the country. Scientists say climate change has made these fires, along with others in Europe, significantly more likely to happen. This year’s blazes in the western U.S. were exacerbated by record-low winter snowfall, depriving the landscape of the moisture that typically seeps from snowpack throughout the summer, and by extreme and long-lasting heat waves that baked the landscape.

And the fires have highlighted another, deadly piece of the puzzle: suburban sprawl.

“What’s happened over the last decades is we’ve had explosive population growth in naturally fire-prone areas,” said Tim Brown, director of the Western Regional Climate Center at the Desert Research Institute in Nevada. “People are moving in to where fire happens.”

The wildland-urban interface, which researchers often call the WUI, is the phrase given to places where housing is sandwiched between paved city centers and forests or grasslands. Researchers have been raising the alarm about the fire risk posed to homes in these areas since the 1980s. As humans burn more fossil fuels and warm the planet, longer and more severe droughts will likely make that risk worse. Reno is the fastest warming city in the U.S., according to the nonprofit Climate Central.

These half-wild, half-suburban neighborhoods remain one of the most rapidly growing types of land in the country, although development has slowed compared to the surge between the 1990s and 2010s. In some places, housing scarcity in cities has pushed home buyers to the outskirts of towns, where building is generally cheaper and...
body.zh: 本文最初由 Grist 发表，并作为气候台合作的一部分转载于此。 专家表示，华盛顿州斯波坎和内华达州里诺最近发生的火灾凸显了郊区扩张的风险。在这两个城市，蔓延的火焰烧毁了建在荒野边缘的房屋。 萨默塞特距离内华达州里诺市中心仅很短的车程，是一个宁静的地方，这里的房屋坐落在死胡同中，可欣赏一览无余的高沙漠景色，道路蜿蜒穿过灌木丛、步道入口和高尔夫球场。但在夏季，几个月的低湿度和炎热的天气很容易导致土地燃烧。 8月22日上午，事情果然发生了。 短短几天内，强风将霍克大火的火焰吹了超过 23 英里，浓烟和橙色天空笼罩了整个城市，导致约 9 万人接到疏散通知。到周三，已有数十栋房屋被毁。两周前，虫火在同一地区北部燃烧了 150 平方英里。 这是美国山火不断恶化的最新情况，今年美国的火灾面积已超过 790 万英亩。类似的故事也在加拿大上演，原住民和安大略省的居民在全国范围内发生了 5,100 多起火灾中首当其冲。科学家表示，气候变化使得这些火灾以及欧洲的其他火灾发生的可能性大大增加。今年美国西部的大火因冬季降雪量创历史新低而加剧，导致整个夏季的积雪失去了通常从积雪中渗出的水分，而且极端而持久的热浪烘烤了大地。 火灾凸显了另一个致命的难题：郊区扩张。 内华达州沙漠研究所西部区域气候中心主任蒂姆·布朗说：“过去几十年来，自然火灾多发地区的人口出现爆炸性增长。” “人们正在搬到发生火灾的地方。” 研究人员通常将荒地与城市界面称为“WUI”，这个短语指的是住房夹在铺好的城市中心和森林或草地之间的地方。自 20 世纪 80 年代以来，研究人员一直对这些地区的房屋火灾风险发出警报。随着人类燃烧更多的化石燃料并使地球变暖，更长时间、更严重的干旱可能会使这种风险变得更加严重。据非营利组织气候中心称，里诺是美国变暖最快的城市。 这些半野生、半郊区的社区仍然是该国增长最快的土地类型之一，尽管与 20 世纪 90 年代至 2010 年代的激增相比，开发速度有所放缓。在一些地方，城市住房稀缺迫使购房者前往城镇郊区，那里的建筑通常更便宜，而且......

reflection.en: The expansion of human settlements into natural landscapes, as seen in Spokane and Reno, brings with it inherent risks. The earth itself seems to groan under the pressure of development, with wildlands becoming tinderboxes and homes caught in the crossfire. This situation calls us to consider our stewardship of creation and the unintended consequences of...
reflection.zh: 人类聚居地向自然景观的扩张，如在斯波坎和里诺所见，带来了固有的风险。大地本身似乎在发展的压力下呻吟，野地变成了火药桶，房屋则卷入了战火。这种情况促使我们反思我们对受造界的管理以及我们选择所带来的意想不到的后果。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: As Death Toll From Nepal Flood Rises, Officials Call to Tackle Warming
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水死亡人数上升，官员呼吁应对气候变暖

summary.en: Five days after a devastating flood swept through Rasuwa, Nepal, the death toll continues to rise. Authorities reported on Monday that 903 people have been confirmed dead, with another 4,247 missing, as the country grapples with a disaster experts suggest may be linked to melting glacial ice.
summary.zh: 尼泊尔拉苏瓦地区发生灾难性洪水五天后，死亡人数持续攀升。当局周一报告称，已有903人确认死亡，另有4247人失踪，该国正努力应对一场专家认为可能与冰川融化有关的灾难。

body.en:
Five days after a calamitous flood washed through Rasuwa, Nepal, the death toll continues to climb. Authorities said Monday that 903 people have been confirmed dead, while another 4,247 are missing, as the country reels from a disaster that experts say may be linked to the melting of glacial ice.

Officials believe the collapse of a glacier on Langtang Lirung peak sent an avalanche of ice and rock careening into a valley below, where it blocked the flow of the Trishuli River. When the rock barrier finally gave way, they say, it unleashed a rush of water and mud several stories high. The floodwaters inundated villages all along the river, not just in Nepal but also in neighboring Tibet, where 16 people are confirmed dead and another 546 are still missing, according to Chinese state media.

Researchers with the HiRisk project, which tracks threats from melting ice in the Himalayas, say that the shrinking and thawing of glaciers may have fueled the disaster. Over the last three decades, Nepali mountains have lost roughly a third of their ice , according to the U.N. Between 1990 and 2020, the glacier on Langtang Lirung retreated roughly 1,500 feet, and experts say the loss of ice may have left the slope more vulnerable to a landslide.

Further upping the risk of collapse was a warm spell that melted snow atop Langtang Lirung in the days before the flood. “That snowmelt had to go somewhere – and it may have supplied the water that lubricated the rockfall,” said Umesh Haritashya , a geoscientist at the University of Dayton.

The upper Himalayas are warming nearly twice as fast as the global average, and August is the warmest time of year in the region. “While scientists are still studying the exact causes of this disaster, it is exactly the type of event that is triggered by climate change,” said Wouter Buytaert , a hydrologist at Imperial College London.

U.N. climate chief Simon Stiell said in a statement that a warming climate “is making tragedies like this one, and so many others around the world, much more likely, frequent, and severe, with vulnerable communities often hardest hit.”

In a press conference on Saturday, Nepal’s foreign minister, Shisir Khanal, called on countries to address warming. “We’d ask the world,” he said, “to take climate change as one of the major challenges that Nepal and its citizens face, and this has to be a global effort.”
body.zh: 尼泊尔拉苏瓦发生灾难性洪水五天后，死亡人数继续攀升。当局周一表示，已确认 903 人死亡，另有 4,247 人失踪，专家称这场灾难可能与冰川融化有关，该国正遭受这场灾难的困扰。 官员们认为，Langtang Lirung峰上的冰川崩塌导致雪崩，冰块和岩石倾泻到下面的山谷中，阻塞了Trishuli河的水流。他们说，当岩石屏障最终崩溃时，它释放出了几层楼高的水和泥浆。据中国官方媒体报道，洪水不仅淹没了尼泊尔，还淹没了邻近的西藏沿河村庄，已确认 16 人死亡，另有 546 人失踪。 HiRisk项目的研究人员追踪喜马拉雅山冰川融化的威胁，他们表示，冰川的缩小和融化可能加剧了这场灾难。联合国称，在过去三十年里，尼泊尔山区大约失去了三分之一的冰。 1990 年至 2020 年间，Langtang Lirung 上的冰川后退了大约 1,500 英尺，专家表示，冰的消失可能使斜坡更容易发生山体滑坡。 洪水发生前几天，Langtang Lirung 山顶的积雪融化，进一步增加了塌陷的风险。代顿大学地球科学家乌梅什·哈里塔什亚 (Umesh Haritashya) 表示：“融雪必须流向某个地方，它可能提供了润滑落石的水。” 专家表示，喜马拉雅山上游的变暖速度几乎是全球平均水平的两倍，而八月是该地区一年中最温暖的时间。伦敦帝国理工学院水文学家 Wouter Buytaert 表示：“虽然科学家仍在研究这场灾难的确切原因，但这正是气候变化引发的事件类型。” 联合国气候变化负责人西蒙·斯蒂尔在一份声明中表示，气候变暖“正在导致像这样的悲剧以及世界各地许多其他悲剧发生，而且发生的可能性更大、更频繁、更严重，脆弱社区往往受到的打击最严重。” 在周六的新闻发布会上，尼泊尔外交部长希西尔·卡纳尔呼吁各国应对气候变暖问题。 “我们要求世界，”他说，“将气候变化视为尼泊尔及其公民面临的主要挑战之一，而这必须是全球的共同努力。”

reflection.en: The earth groans, as the Apostle Paul wrote, and this flood in Nepal is a stark reminder of that reality. The melting glacier that likely triggered this disaster points to the deep interconnectedness of our world and the impact of environmental changes on vulnerable communities. May we heed the calls to address warming and care for the creation entrusted to...
reflection.zh: 正如使徒保罗所写，万物都在一同叹息，而尼泊尔的这场洪水正是这一现实的严峻提醒。可能引发这场灾难的冰川融化，揭示了我们世界深刻的相互联系，以及环境变化对脆弱社区的影响。愿我们听从应对气候变暖的呼吁，并照管那托付给我们的受造之物。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

Since it premiered just over a year ago at last year’s Telluride Film Festival , mainstream distributors and streamers wouldn’t touch the documentary “ Ask E. Jean ,” which profiles advice columnist E. Jean Carroll amid her legal battle for defamation with President Trump. The film ‘s director Ivy Meeropol outwardly has blamed “The Trump Effect” for why buyers have “ghosted” her in getting the film released. So Meeropol has turned to some unconventional measures.

Over the last several months, “Ask E. Jean” has played in over 100 theaters across the country and sold out New York’s IFC Center, leading to a five-week engagement of the film in NY, as well as additional screenings in over 90 cities and 30 states. The audience demand has been there, even if other distributors have feared the commercial prospects of a political documentary or quite simply feared retribution from the Trump administration. Merger: ‘I Don’t Know How This Goes Through’ Venice’s ‘Burgundy’ Finds ‘The Truffle Hunters’ Directors Seduced by French Wine Country — Watch Exclusive Clip

But it has done so via the joint efforts of five different companies whom have all come together to help distribute it through more grassroots means: Impact Partners, which helped produce and finance “Ask E. Jean,” Theorem Media, an indie film distribution studio, took on the non theatrical and eventized theatrical distribution and organic social, Roco Films, which has led educational access for schools, colleges, and students, Abramorama , which handled the physical theatrical distribution, and Kinema , which is a platform that gives communities the means to host their own screenings and viewing parties . The companies don’t normally release films together, but this one was special.

Now, all five of those collaborators are again teaming up to finally bring “Ask E. Jean” to streaming on Kinema, where it has just launched today , September 2, for a premium video on demand window, IndieWire can reveal exclusively. The film is available for digital rental for $8.99 via Kinema, and it is continuing its theatrical run as well.

David Bowie shares the bill with starmen, firefighters and Walt Disney wolves at the 10th anniversary edition of Venice Immersive, the film festival’s pioneering...
summary.zh: 数百张这位明星的未公开照片在威尼斯电影节上展出，同时还有探索野火、狼群和恒星诞生的虚拟世界。大卫·鲍伊与星际人、消防员和迪士尼的狼一起亮相威尼斯沉浸式展的十周年庆典，这是电影节展示新叙事形式的先驱平台。由数百张前所未见的图像组成的3D纪录片《大卫·鲍伊：未见未闻》（David Bowie: Unseen...

body.en: Hundreds of unseen images of the star feature at the Venice film festival, alongside virtual worlds exploring wildfires, wolves and the birth of stars David Bowie shares the bill with starmen, firefighters and Walt Disney wolves at the 10th anniversary edition of Venice Immersive, the film festival’s pioneering showcase for new forms of storytelling. David Bowie: Unseen Unheard – a 3D documentary featuring hundreds of previously unseen images – is among 69 XR (extended reality) pieces playing at the event’s regular base on Lazzaretto Vecchio, a repurposed small island off the Venice Lido. Venice Immersive’s 10th birthday marks a milestone for an event which aims to provide a bridge between emergent technology and traditional narrative cinema. But the programme’s organisers are at pains to emphasise the ongoing scope of a project that has in recent years prompted similar sections at the Cannes, Geneva and Toronto film festivals. “This is not a retrospective,” declares the official festival blurb that welcomes guests to the island. It almost sounds like a warning. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在威尼斯电影节10周年纪念版上，数百张看不见的威尼斯电影节明星特写图片，以及探索野火、狼和明星诞生的虚拟世界，大卫·鲍伊（ David Bowie ）与史塔门（ Starmen ）、消防员和沃尔特·迪斯尼（ Walt Disney ）狼分享了这项法案。威尼斯电影节是讲故事新形式的开创性展示。大卫·鲍伊（ David Bowie ） ：《闻所未闻》（ Unseen Unheard ）是一部3D纪录片，其中包含数百张以前看不到的图像，在威尼斯丽都（ Lido ）重新利用的小岛拉扎雷托·维奇奥（ Lazzaretto Vecchio ）的活动常规基地播放的69部XR （扩展现实）作品。威尼斯沉浸式的10岁生日是一个里程碑，旨在为新兴技术和传统叙事电影之间提供桥梁。但该计划的组织者正在努力强调一个项目的持续范围，该项目近年来在戛纳，日内瓦和多伦多电影节上引发了类似的部分。“这不是一个回顾展，”欢迎房客来到岛上的官方节日宣传语宣称。这几乎听起来像是一个警告。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary uses extended reality to explore vast themes, including the birth of stars. It reminds us that even as we explore human creativity and the cosmos through technology, the heavens themselves bear witness to a grandeur beyond our making. The Psalmist declares, "The heavens declare the glory of Yahweh," a truth that resonates whether viewed...
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片运用扩展现实技术探索宏大的主题，包括恒星的诞生。它提醒我们，即使我们通过科技探索人类的创造力和宇宙，苍穹本身也见证着超越我们创造的宏伟。诗人宣告：“诸天述说雅伟的荣耀”，这一真理无论通过镜头还是虚拟世界来观看，都回响在耳畔。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

summary.en: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining … Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film,

body.en: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining … Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film, Bros: After the Screaming Stops . That documentary worked brilliantly because its subjects seemed so sweetly but devastatingly lacking in discretion or self-awareness that everything they said landed like a line from a Christopher Guest parody. They couldn’t help themselves. In terms of a character study, storied football manager José Mourinho is a very different kettle of cold fish. Like the Goss twins, he takes himself very seriously indeed, but that’s pretty much where the similarities end. He’s something of a closed book. “You are pushing me to speak about myself,” he says, towards the end of the final part of this series. “And I don’t want to.” Which is fair enough but it does beg the question: why then, would you agree to be the subject of an in-depth three part documentary series? Mourinho is on Netflix Continue reading...
body.zh: 足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥在《兄弟：尖叫停止之后》创作者制作的三部曲中担任主演。别指望它会这么有趣……在这部迷你剧的导演乔·皮尔曼 (Joe Pearlman) 之前的作品中，可以数 2018 年的一部具有启发性和搞笑性的电影《兄弟：尖叫停止后》。这部纪录片取得了出色的效果，因为它的主题看起来如此甜蜜，但严重缺乏判断力或自我意识，以至于他们所说的一切都像克里斯托弗·盖斯特（Christopher Guest）戏仿中的台词一样。他们无法自拔。就性格研究而言，传奇足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥是一个非常不同的冷鱼。和戈斯双胞胎一样，他确实非常认真地对待自己，但相似之处也仅此而已。他就像一本合上的书。 “你迫使我谈论我自己，”他在本系列最后一部分的结尾说道。 “而我不想。”这很公平，但它确实引出了一个问题：那么，为什么你会同意成为一个深入的三部分纪录片系列的主题呢？穆里尼奥在 Netflix 上继续阅读...

reflection.en: José Mourinho's documentary is critiqued for his unwillingness to truly open up, despite the public platform it offers. This reminds us that fame and public attention, like a refiner's fire, test a person's true character, revealing what lies beneath the surface. When given a stage, our authenticity is often put to the test, showing whether we are willing...
reflection.zh: 穆里尼奥的纪录片因他不愿真正敞开心扉而受到批评，尽管它提供了一个公共平台。这提醒我们，名声和公众关注，如同炼金的炉火，考验着一个人的真实品格，揭示其表象之下的本质。当我们被赋予一个舞台时，我们的真诚往往会受到考验，展现我们是否愿意被真实地了解。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Monsters of God review – a messy feud between rival reptile smugglers gets the Tiger King treatment
title.zh: 《上帝的怪物》影评：一场爬行动物走私犯之间的混乱恩怨，获得“虎王”式待遇

summary.en: A new documentary, "Monsters of God," explores the underworld of the animal trade through the lens of a messy feud between rival reptile smugglers. Director Eric Goode presents two figures whose intense rivalry and accusations are compared to the popular "Tiger King" series, highlighting the dramatic and often absurd...
summary.zh: 一部名为《上帝的怪物》的新纪录片，通过两位敌对爬行动物走私犯之间混乱的恩怨，探讨了动物贸易的地下世界。导演埃里克·古德呈现的这两个人物，他们之间激烈的竞争和相互指控被比作热门剧集《虎王》，揭示了这个非法世界中戏剧性且往往荒谬的冲突。

body.en: Director Eric Goode has found two enemies to rival Joe Exotic and Carole Baskin in his new documentary about the animal trade’s underworld Through the fear and general miasma of the Covid pandemic, TV brought people together like never before. Among the most-watched series of 2020 was of course Tiger King, Netflix’s hit about an improbably twisty feud between a gay, polyamorous big-cat breeder and convicted felon, and the conservationist rival whom he accused of murder (more specifically, of feeding her missing husband to the tigers in her sanctuary – which she denies). It was the perfect hit for quarantine: bold and ridiculous enough to get everyone talking, and with precisely no bearing on the grief and awfulness that was all around. Producer and co-director Eric Goode has made a smattering of Tiger King follow-ups since then, as well as another series, Chimp Crazy, about the self-described Dolly Parton of the primate world. His latest project – a co-production between his own outfit, Goode Films, HBO, and A24 – continues the theme, focusing this time on the reptile trade and taking its lead from the 2008 book The Lizard King by journalist Bryan Christy. It’s stuffed full of wild stories and even wilder characters: there are canny smugglers, underworld crime gangs, and even legitimate zoos that are said to have turned a blind eye to the provenance of their big, scaly friends. The series is centred on the US – although clearly the supply chain is global – and the two men who kickstarted the illegal trade: Hank Molt and copycat trader Tommy Crutchfield. Like Joe Exotic and Carole Baskin before them, there is no love lost between Crutchfield and Molt, and no odd biographical detail too trivial to skip over. Hank, says Tommy, “will turn anything good into bad”, while Hank reckons that Tommy is “one of the angriest and most bitter people I’ve ever met”. Along the way we learn that Hank used to be a mayonnaise salesman, and that Tommy worked at an extremely on-the-nose Florida establishment named Snake-a-Torium as a teenager, where he would later have his wedding reception. What follows is the story not only of their enduring beef and betrayals, but of other adjacent vendettas in the illicit reptilian market. Despite environmental concerns becoming increasingly en vogue in the late 60s, a “don’t ask, don’t tell” attitude still pervaded the world of wildlife trading, with many zoos happy to acquire what they needed from whoever happened to have it. There were, however, serious consequences for some of the creatures involved. With the police on his back, Molt once buried a stash of animals alive in New Jersey’s Pine Barrens, a location which would later become infamous via The Sopranos. When he was eventually arrested, Crutchfield would become the go-to...
body.zh: 导演埃里克·古德（Eric Goode）在他关于动物贸易黑社会的新纪录片中找到了两个可以与乔·异国情调（Joe Exotic）和卡罗尔·巴斯金（Carole Baskin）匹敌的敌人。在新冠疫情的恐惧和普遍的瘴气中，电视以前所未有的方式将人们聚集在一起。 2020 年收视率最高的剧集当然是《虎王》，这部 Netflix 热播剧讲述了一名同性恋、多角恋大型猫科动物饲养员和被定罪的重罪犯，以及他指控谋杀（更具体地说，将她失踪的丈夫喂给她庇护所里的老虎——她否认）的自然资源保护主义竞争对手之间的矛盾。这是隔离期间的完美打击：大胆而荒谬，足以让每个人都议论纷纷，却与周围的悲伤和可怕毫无关系。从那时起，制片人兼联合导演埃里克·古德制作了一些《虎王》的后续作品，以及另一部剧集《疯狂黑猩猩》，讲述了自称灵长类动物世界的多莉·帕顿的故事。他的最新项目——由他自己的公司 Goode Films、HBO 和 A24 联合制作——延续了这一主题，这次重点关注爬行动物贸易，并以记者 Bryan Christy 2008 年出版的《蜥蜴王》一书为主导。它充满了疯狂的故事，甚至更疯狂的人物：有精明的走私者、黑社会犯罪团伙，甚至还有据说对他们的大而有鳞的朋友的出处视而不见的合法动物园。该系列以美国为中心（尽管供应链显然是全球性的）以及发起非法贸易的两个人：汉克·莫尔特（Hank Molt）和模仿商人汤米·克拉奇菲尔德（Tommy Crutchfield）。就像之前的乔·异国情调和卡罗尔·巴斯金一样，克拉奇菲尔德和莫尔特之间没有失去爱情，也没有琐碎而无法跳过的奇怪的传记细节。汤米说，汉克“会把任何好事变成坏事”，而汉克认为汤米是“我见过的最愤怒、最痛苦的人之一”。一路上我们了解到，汉克曾经是一名蛋黄酱推销员，而汤米十几岁时曾在佛罗里达州一家名为 Snake-a-Torium 的非常引人注目的餐厅工作，后来他在那里举办了婚宴。接下来的故事不仅讲述了他们持久的争执和背叛，还讲述了非法爬行动物市场上其他相邻的仇杀。尽管环境问题在 20 世纪 60 年代末变得越来越流行，但“不问、不说”的态度仍然普遍存在于野生动物贸易领域，许多动物园乐于从碰巧拥有它们的人那里获得所需的东西。然而，这对一些涉及的生物造成了严重后果。莫尔特背着警察，曾在新泽西州的松林贫瘠之地活埋了一批动物，这个地方后来因《黑道家族》而臭名昭著。当他最终被捕时，克拉奇菲尔德将成为首选......

reflection.en: The documentary about rival reptile smugglers, likened to the "Tiger King" phenomenon, exposes a messy feud driven by intense rivalry and accusations. This kind of conflict often stems from a lack of humility, where individuals prioritize their own interests and perceived superiority. Yahweh calls us to a different path, urging us to value others above...
reflection.zh: 这部关于爬行动物走私犯之间激烈争斗的纪录片，被比作“虎王”现象，揭示了由强烈竞争和指控驱动的混乱恩怨。这种冲突往往源于缺乏谦卑，个人将自己的利益和自认为的优越感置于首位。雅伟呼召我们走一条不同的道路，敦促我们在分歧中也要看别人比自己强。

verse.textEn: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or vain conceit. Rather, in humility value others above yourselves.
verse.textZh: 凡事不可结党，不可贪图虚浮的荣耀；只要存心谦卑，各人看别人比自己强。

title.en: ‘Led us down such a dark path’: documentary explores how 9/11 changed America
title.zh: “把我们引向如此黑暗的道路”：纪录片探讨 9/11 如何改变了美国

summary.en: The Netflix film 'Turning Point: Generation 9/11' examines the lives of those profoundly affected by the 2001 terrorist attacks. As the US approaches a point where half its population was born after 9/11 or was too young to remember it, the film's director compares the event's distance to the bombing of Hiroshima,...
summary.zh: Netflix 电影《转折点：9/11 一代》探讨了 2001 年恐怖袭击事件的深刻影响。随着美国即将迎来半数人口出生在 9/11 之后或对该事件记忆模糊的时刻，该片导演将此次事件的久远感比作广岛原子弹爆炸，凸显了其持久的影响。

body.en: In Netflix film Turning Point: Generation 9/11, the lives of people forever impacted by the terrorist attack in 2001 are explored Twenty-five years on, memory is giving way to history. Soon the US will cross the point where half its population were born after 11 September 2001 or were too young to remember the day that terrorists crashed planes into the World Trade Center in New York, the Pentagon in northern Virginia and a field in Shanksville, Pennsylvania. “When I do that math, I get to the bomb at Hiroshima – that’s how distant it is,” says Brian Knappenberger, 56, director of a new Netflix documentary, Turning Point: Generation 9/11 . “When we talk about the second world war, for our generation it seemed like a long time ago but, for the current generation of 20-year-olds, that’s how long ago it was.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 在 Netflix 电影《转折点：9/11 世代》中，探索了 2001 年遭受恐怖袭击永远影响的人们的生活。二十五年过去了，记忆正在让位于历史。很快，美国将有一半人口出生于 2001 年 9 月 11 日之后，或者年龄太小，不记得恐怖分子将飞机撞向纽约世贸中心、弗吉尼亚州北部五角大楼和宾夕法尼亚州尚克斯维尔田野的那一天。 56 岁的布莱恩·纳彭伯格 (Brian Knappenberger) 是 Netflix 一部新纪录片《转折点：第 9/11 代》的导演，他说：“当我计算时，我会想到广岛的原子弹——这就是它的距离。” “当我们谈论第二次世界大战时，对于我们这一代人来说，这似乎是很久以前的事了，但对于现在这一代 20 岁的人来说，那就是很久以前的事了。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: The documentary 'Turning Point: Generation 9/11' revisits the profound and lasting impact of the 9/11 attacks, which the director describes as leading America down a 'dark path.' This phrase captures the difficult truth that responding to evil with further conflict can perpetuate suffering and unintended consequences, a cycle that Scripture warns against....
reflection.zh: 纪录片《转折点：9/11 一代》重温了 9/11 袭击事件深远而持久的影响，导演称其将美国引向了一条“黑暗的道路”。这句话恰当地概括了一个严峻的事实：以冲突回应邪恶可能会延续苦难和产生意想不到的后果，这正是圣经所警示的循环。‘以善胜恶’（罗马书 12:21）的呼召，即使面对深重的创伤和损失，也促使我们寻求治愈与和解之路。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: The Black Garden review – haunting study of growing up in war-torn Nagorno-Karabakh
title.zh: 《黑花园》评论——对在战火纷飞的纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫长大的孩子的凄美研究

summary.en: Alexis Pazoumian’s documentary follows Samvel and Avo, two preteen boys whose lives will be unavoidably scarred by brutal conflict. After the Soviet Union collapsed in 1991, a decades-long territorial dispute exploded in the region of Nagorno-Karabakh, as its largely Armenian population fought against countless...
summary.zh: 亚历克西斯·帕祖米扬的纪录片讲述了萨姆维尔和阿沃两个十岁出头的男孩的故事，他们的生活将不可避免地被残酷的冲突所伤害。苏联于1991年解体后，一场持续数十年的领土争端在纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫地区爆发，当地主要是亚美尼亚人口与阿塞拜疆军队进行了无数次军事战役的斗争。这部影片拍摄历时三年，于2023年纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫分离主义政...

body.en: Alexis Pazoumian’s documentary follows Samvel and Avo, two preteen boys whose lives will be unavoidably scarred by brutal conflict After the Soviet Union collapsed in 1991, a decades-long territorial dispute exploded in the region of Nagorno-Karabakh, as its largely Armenian population fought against countless military campaigns from the Azerbaijani army. Shot over the course of three eventful years, which culminated in the surrender of Nagorno-Karabakh’s separatist government in 2023 , Alexis Pazoumian’s haunting documentary harnesses the collective turmoil that dominated generations of Armenians. From the elderly to the very young, the community are united by an unwavering sense of pride, one that carries them through never-ending bloodshed and displacement. The film opens with the harrowing sight of a bombed-out school in the small village of Talish, where childlike innocence contrasts with wartime trauma. Samvel and Avo, two preteen boys, roam through the wreckage and scavenge for remains of past normalcy, like the scattered notebooks left behind by their former classmates. The threat of the enemy, however, is drilled into every aspect of their daily life. At school, they learn how to assemble guns, and at family gatherings, they join in songs that speak of heroic valour. That the children here – boys and girls – will grow up to become soldiers is a foregone conclusion. Continue reading...
body.zh: 亚历克西斯·帕祖米安 (Alexis Pazoumian) 的纪录片讲述了萨姆维尔 (Samvel) 和阿沃 (Avo) 这两个青春期男孩的故事，他们的生活将不可避免地因残酷的冲突而受到创伤。 1991 年苏联解体后，纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫地区爆发了长达数十年的领土争端，该地区主要是亚美尼亚人，与阿塞拜疆军队的无数军事行动进行了斗争。亚历克西斯·帕祖米安 (Alexis Pazoumian) 这部令人难忘的纪录片历时三年多的时间拍摄，最终导致纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫分离主义政府于 2023 年投降，讲述了统治几代亚美尼亚人的集体动乱。从老年人到年幼的孩子，社区都以一种坚定不移的自豪感团结在一起，这种自豪感使他们经历了永无休止的流血和流离失所。影片以塔利什小村庄一所被炸毁的学校的悲惨景象开始，孩子般的纯真与战时的创伤形成鲜明对比。萨姆维尔和阿沃是两个青春期前的男孩，他们在废墟中漫步，寻找过去常态的遗迹，比如他们以前的同学留下的散落的笔记本。然而，敌人的威胁渗透到他们日常生活的方方面面。在学校，他们学习如何组装枪支，在家庭聚会上，他们一起唱颂英雄勇气的歌曲。这里的孩子们——男孩和女孩——长大后成为士兵已成定局。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The documentary "The Black Garden" brings to light the profound impact of war on children, focusing on Samvel and Avo. Their young lives are shaped by conflict, a stark reminder of the voiceless who bear the brunt of adult disputes. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute."...
reflection.zh: 纪录片《黑花园》揭示了战争对儿童的深远影响，聚焦于萨姆维尔和阿沃。他们年幼的生活被冲突所塑造，这鲜明地提醒我们那些承受着成人争端重担的无声者。《箴言》31:8-9呼吁我们“为不能自辩的开口，为所有困苦者判定公正”。这部影片有力地证明了这一呼召，敦促我们铭记并倡导那些卷入全球冲突战火中的儿童。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: The Isaac Mizrahi Documentary ‘Unzipped’ Is the Ultimate ’90s Fashion Portrait — Watch the Trailer
title.zh: 纪录片《Unzipped》是终极的90年代时尚肖像——观看预告片

summary.en: Douglas Reeve's 1995 documentary follows Mizrahi into his 1994 fall collection. Access was helped amply by the fact that they were dating at the time.
summary.zh: 道格拉斯·里夫1995年的纪录片跟随米兹拉希进入他1994年的秋季系列。由于当时他们正在约会，因此获得了充分的便利。

body.en:
By providing your information, you agree to our Terms of Use and our Privacy Policy . We use vendors that may also process your information to help provide our services. This site is protected by reCAPTCHA Enterprise and the Google Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply.

Filmmaker Douglas Keeve’s 1995 documentary “ Unzipped ” follows fashion designer and eventual mogul Isaac Mizrahi, then the director’s boyfriend, into his fall 1994 collection. The ’90s-centric movie remains the ultimate portrait of New York’s high fashion world at the time, with guest appearances including Cindy Crawford, Naomi Campbell, Linda Evangelista, and Kate Moss. Plus, the film won the audience award at the 1995 Sundance Film Festival. Now, Janus Films is bringing the movie back to theaters courtesy of a new restoration. Watch the trailer below.

Here’s the synopsis courtesy of Janus Films: “Designer Isaac Mizrahi proved a force of nature on the road to his legendary fall 1994 collection, a career-defining triumph that was documented with an effervescent intimacy by Douglas Keeve, Mizrahi’s then-partner. Both a time capsule of the buoyant, raucous 1990s, when pop culture and high art became interchangeable, and a vérité-style, in-the-trenches report on the daily agonies and ecstasies of the creative process, this seminal artistic portrait — sumptuously shot by Ellen Kuras and Robert Leacock — transcends glitz and glamour to offer an extraordinary view of the charisma and force of will inherent to genius, as well as its personal costs.” Related Stories ‘Coyote vs. Acme,’ Viewed as Unreleasable by Warner Bros., Just Beat a Jacob Elordi and Ridley Scott Movie at the Box Office From Timothée Chalamet and Tom Cruise to Cynthia Erivo: It’s Time for Some Overdue Actors to Finally Win an Oscar

Charli XCX recently told Vogue : “Directed by Douglas Keeve, it follows Isaac Mizrahi as he gets ready for his New York Fashion Week collection. If you love fashion, you have to see this documentary. All the legends are there — Kate, Naomi, Christy — and even Galliano and Polly Mellen. But most importantly, the film perfectly captures the artist’s creative process: bursts of inspiration, self-doubt, vulnerability, and finally, triumph.”

Janus Films opens “Unzipped” on Friday, September 25 at Film Forum in New York City. Then, the film opens in Los Angeles at the Laemmle Royal and Glendale on Friday, October 9. A national rollout will follow. The Sundance Institute and UCLA Film & Television Archive digitally restored the film.
